items.information: * Registrants will be accepted in the order that they pay, not the order that they register. Please be patient with us as we manually accept all eligible competitors. **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Lunch will end at the scheduled time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. items.name: Please Be Quiet Pickering Winter 2024
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Please Be Quiet This isn't your typical speed solving competition as ***3x3x3 Fewest Moves (FMC)*** and ***Blindfolded events*** are the only events. Blindfolded events require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration, and FMC is an exam-style event in which competitors spend up to an hour finding the shortest solution they can and writing it down on paper. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 Cube event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ## Note for New Competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to compete in FMC or solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. You can also follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ## Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff.

All competitors should read the Competitor Responsibilities tab before registering **How to Change/Cancel Your Registration** Competitors can modify their registration through the Register tab. Competitors can also change or cancel by emailing the organization team with the following information: 1. Intent to change/cancel registration 2. Desired changes to registration 3. Name (and WCA ID, if applicable) of the competitor. In the event that a competitor cancels their registration, they will only receive a 75% refund. The deadline to change/cancel your registration is January 12th, 2023, 5:00 PM Mountain Time. **Waitlist Procedure** If registration fills up, we will place competitors on a waitlist. In the event a competitor drops from the competition, competitors will be accepted from the waitlist in the order we receive payment. Competitors can be accepted from the waitlist until January 12th at 5:00 PM MST. You will receive a full refund if you are still on the waitlist by then.

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło aż 60 turnieje w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.name: Barely Awake Boulder 2024
items.information: We are excited to welcome competitors back to Boulder for the first time since 2016, and for the second ever 24+ hour competition held in North America! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important! This competition has a 150 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition! Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first official competition, this video will provide you with most of the information you need. https://youtu.be/dPL3eV-A0ww If this is your first competition, please be present 15 minutes before the competitor tutorial at 11:00 AM, which means you should plan to arrive at 10:45 AM. If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (2024-01-20 00:00 UTC)

items.information: ## SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring up to **two** spectators with them. ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ## SPONSORSHIP A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who are sponsoring the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ## VENUE HEAT This is an indoor venue with fans, but no aircon. It might get quite warm if we have a hot weekend. Please be aware of this, bring enough water, and make any preparations needed. #### About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

items.name: Desafío Maipú NxN 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbGRmIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4ce819179ad510ec318e2923166dc018caa0ee86/A%C3%B1adir%20un%20subt%C3%ADtulo.png) **Español** El Desafío Maipú NxN 2024 es un emocionante torneo de cubos Rubik que promete ser un evento de vanguardia en el mundo de los rompecabezas tridimensionales. En esta competición, entusiastas del cubo se reunirán para poner a prueba sus habilidades resolviendo cubos NxN, desde los clásicos 3x3 hasta los desafiantes cubos NxN de dimensiones superiores. Este torneo representa la oportunidad perfecta para demostrar destreza, estrategia y rapidez en la resolución de estos enigmáticos acertijos. Con una combinación de competencia feroz y comunidad apasionada, el Desafío Maipú NxN 2024 sin duda será un evento imperdible en el calendario de los amantes del cubo Rubik. **English** The Maipú NxN Challenge 2024 is an exciting Rubik's Cube tournament that promises to be a cutting-edge event in the world of three-dimensional puzzles. In this competition, cube enthusiasts will gather to test their skills by solving NxN cubes, ranging from the classic 3x3 to the challenging higher-dimensional NxN cubes. This tournament represents the perfect opportunity to showcase dexterity, strategy, and speed in solving these enigmatic puzzles. With a combination of fierce competition and a passionate community, the Maipú NxN Challenge 2024 will undoubtedly be a must-attend event on the Rubik's Cube lovers' calendar.

venue.name: UNC Charlotte Popp Martin Student Union

items.information: **NOTE: THERE IS NO STANDARD 3x3x3 CUBE EVENT HELD AT THIS COMPETITION. All competitors at all skill levels are welcome, however most of the events held at the competition are more advanced. The only two sighted events are 6x6x6 Cube and 7x7x7 Cube. The rest of the events are blindfolded or 3x3 Fewest Moves (which is writing out a solution to a scramble in 1 hour). We will NOT be teaching competitors how to do these events. Competitors are expected to know how to compete in the events they register for.** Please always include your **name** and competition name in any email that you send to us. All competitors must read the "Competitor Information" tab prior to registering. Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email. Only **one** guest per competitor will be allowed. **No outside food or drink is allowed in the venue**

items.information: **Português** O Summer Kube Vitória 2024 é o 17º Campeonato Oficial do Espírito Santo. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.information: ##### *English version is below* #### **Deutsch:** Nach einem erfolgreichem Fasching Turnier im letzten Jahr, dürfen wir auch dieses Jahr wieder Vienna Fasching 2024 als offizelles WCA Turnier ankündigen. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold, Lucas Höglinger und delegiert von Viktor Kalmar und Pranjal Khan. Diesmal findet die Competition im Jugendgästehaus Brigittenau statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ----- #### **English:** After a successful Fasching Competition last year, we are once again happy to announce Vienna Fasching 2024 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by David Dinh, Jeremia Neuhold, Lucas Höglinger and delegated by Viktor Kalmar and Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.name: Christchurch Mind Games 2024
items.information: Christchurch Mind Games 2024 is an official World Cube Association (WCA) sanctioned speedcubing competition. It is focused on some of the more mentally demanding events, that are given less of a focus in normal competitions - blindfolded and fewest moves solving, specifically. This competition is open to all competitors regardless of age, experience, or skill. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary. Please make sure to read all the information in the FAQ and other tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs. **The main event of this competition is Fewest Moves** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0JPIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--09f328966024b349b182c10e5943a3983f83b9cd/snz_logo_v06.png) [Website](https://speedcubing.nz) | [Facebook](https://facebook.com/speedcubingnz) | [Instagram](https://instagram.com/speedcubingnz)

items.information: Qafqazın ən böyük şəhəri olan, qartal şəklində Azərbaycanın şərqində və Xəzərin sahilində yerləşən gözəl Bakımıza xoş gəlmisiniz! Şərq Qartalı 2024 (Eagle of the East 2024) bütün iştirakçılara açıq olan, dost mühitində keçiriləcək əyləncəli bir Rubik kubu yarışıdır. Uzun bir aradan sonra yenidən keçirilən bu ənənəvi yarışda bu il də çoxlu iştirakçı görməyi ümid edirik. Eagle of the East 2024 yarışı [Azərbaycan Kub Assosiasiyası](https://www.facebook.com/officialACA/) tərəfindən təşkil olunur. Welcome once again to Baku – largest city in Caucasus, beautifully situated by the eagle-like east part of Azerbaijan! Eagle of the East 2024 is a friendly and relaxed cube competition open to all who wish to participate. After a long break, we decided to arrange this traditional competition again and we are hoping for many participants also this year. Eagle of the East 2024 competition is organized by [Azerbaijan Cube Association](https://www.facebook.com/officialACA/).

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the first Cape Town competition for 2024. Dust off your cubes and get ready to set some PB's - or even records! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket. Please see **Registration Requirements** below. ### SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring 2-3 spectators with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png) A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ### LUCKY DRAW During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. In 2024, we are anticipating being able to host one competition every season in each of the cities of Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban, as well as other regular events in Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Limpopo, and more! If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to bring competitive speedcubing to the country, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact).

Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have fun! #### ATTENTION ##### It is mandatory to fill in the following form with the name of the competitor and guests to enter the condominium. items.name: Beginner Cubing Delmenhorst 2024
items.information: **English** We are looking forward to welcome you at the first competition in Delmenhorst and the third one in Lower Saxony! **This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** The registration process will reserve 35% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. **Registrations will be accepted based on the following:** * 35 spots (35% of spots) are initially reserved for new competitors. * 65 spots (65% of spots) are initially available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If more than 35 new competitors register before 65 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the 35 spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Deutsch** Wir freuen uns euch auf der ersten Competition in Delmenhorst und der dritten in Niedersachsen begrüßen zu dürfen! **Dieser Wettbewerb ist Teil des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** Bei der Anmeldung werden 35% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmer gelten Teilnehmer ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2024. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmer haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2023 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmer müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. **Anmeldungen werden nach folgenden Kriterien angenommen:** * 35 Plätze (35% der Plätze) sind zunächst für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. * 65 Plätze (65% der Plätze) sind zunächst für wiederkehrende Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" verfügbar. * Wenn sich mehr als 35 neue Teilnehmer anmelden, bevor die 65 Plätze von den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern besetzt sind, werden alle weiteren neuen Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" zusammen mit den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugelassen. * Wenn die 35 für neue Teilnehmer reservierten Plätze zwei Wochen vor dem Wettbewerb nicht durch neue Teilnehmer besetzt sind, werden die verbleibenden Plätze bis zum Teilnehmerlimit den bereits registrierten wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugewiesen.

items.information: ###Português O Schoolmark Open está de volta! Com algumas mudanças e surpresas, porém com a mesma atmosfera que tornou as primeiras edições tão boas! Algumas informações importantes: * É imprescindível entender as regras, conforme **[Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)** * A competição é aberta a qualquer pessoa que deseje participar, indepentende de idade, nacionalidade, ou velocidade de resolução. * Além disso, a competição também é aberta a acompanhantes e espectadores. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz dos competidores. **Atenção**: Esta competição terá limite de competitores. Inscreva-se somente se você tem **certeza que irá participar.** Em caso de desistência, por favor **entrar em contato com a organização ([felipeqcardim@gmail.com](mailto:felipeqcardim@gmail.com))** As inscrições deverão ser pagas **via Stripe** na aba de **Inscrever.** ###English Schoolmark Open is back! With a few changes and surprises, but with the same atmosphere that made the first editions so great! Some important information: * It's essential to understand the rules, as in the **[WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)** * The competition is open to any person that wants to participate, independent of age, nationality, or solving speed. * Besides that, the competition is also open to guests and spectators. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said in WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess. Every event will be divided in at least two groups in first round, in a group you'll compete, and in another you'll help as staff. **Attention**: This competition has a competitor limit. Sign up only if you are **sure you will attend**. In case of withdrawal, please **contact the organization ([felipeqcardim@gmail.com](mailto:felipeqcardim@gmail.com)).** Entries must be paid **through Stripe** in the **Register** tab.

The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: * 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * Initially, 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If greather than 50% of new competitors register before 50% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **This competition is a series competition with [Minnesota Newcomer Saturday 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MinnesotaNewcomerSaturday2024). items.name: Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0ppIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--7074cb88987f8a1665e68652fe09ce8f6b104f3b/image.png) Ξεκινά η συναρπαστική σειρά των διαγωνισμών για το 2024 με το 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024', τον πρώτο διαγωνισμό της χρονιάς, αφιερωμένο στους νέους λάτρεις του cubing! Με μεγάλη χαρά και ενθουσιασμό ανοίγουμε την αυλαία για μια σειρά από διαγωνισμούς, όπου νέοι συμμετέχοντες θα έχουν την ευκαιρία να αναδείξουν το ταλέντο και την αγάπη τους για το cubing. Το 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024' θα είναι μια πρώτη ευκαιρία για τους νέους cubers να γευτούν την μαγεία του ανταγωνισμού και να γνωρίσουν την κοινότητα από κοντά. Μην χάσετε την ευκαιρία να γίνετε μέρος αυτής της μοναδικής εμπειρίας. Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε για την πρόκληση και ελάτε να γιορτάσουμε μαζί το πάθος για το cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) The exciting series of competitions for 2024 begins with the 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024', the first competition of the year, dedicated to new "cubing enthusiasts"! With great joy and excitement, we open the curtain on a series of competitions where new participants will have the opportunity to showcase their talent and love for cubing. The 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024' will be a first chance for them to taste the magic of competition and get to know the community up close. Don't miss the chance to be a part of this unique experience. Grab your cubes, get ready for the challenge and come celebrate the passion for cubing together! Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

A nossa competição é formada por alguns competidores experientes, mas sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. - Procure se divertir bastante! **English** **Free Registration.** Please only register if you are certain that you will be able to participate in the competition. It will be a pleasure to receive you and we have some tips for you, competitors and companions: - Arrive at the competition site 30 minutes before the modality that will participate; - The cube you will be competing in must be in good condition, so take good care of it; - At the time of the awards, at the end of Sunday, we will draw some cubes for the competitors. Only win who is present and no one can win twice; - If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. Our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, but we will always have room for new cubists. - Try to have a lot of fun!

items.name: German Newcomer Day 2024
items.information: **English** **This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. **Registrations will be accepted based on the following:** * 60 spots (50% of spots) are initially reserved for new competitors. * 60 spots (50% of spots) are initially are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If more than 60 new competitors register before 60 spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the 60 spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Deutsch** **Dieser Wettbewerb ist Teil des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month 2024.** Bei der Anmeldung werden 50% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmer gelten Teilnehmer ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2024. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmer haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2023 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmer müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. **Anmeldungen werden nach folgenden Kriterien angenommen:** * 60 Plätze (50% der Plätze) sind zunächst für neue Teilnehmer reserviert. * 60 Plätze (50% der Plätze) sind zunächst für wiederkehrende Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" verfügbar. * Wenn sich mehr als 60 neue Teilnehmer anmelden, bevor die 60 Plätze von den zurückgekehrten Teilnehmern besetzt sind, werden alle weiteren neuen Teilnehmer nach dem Prinzip "Wer zuerst kommt, mahlt zuerst" zusammen mit den wiederkehrenden Teilnehmern zugelassen. * Wenn die 60 für neue Teilnehmer reservierten Plätze zwei Wochen vor dem Wettbewerb nicht durch neue Teilnehmer besetzt sind, werden die verbleibenden Plätze bis zum Teilnehmerlimit den bereits registrierten Teilnehmern zugewiesen.

Natjecatelji koji imaju WCA ID od 2023. godine ili ranije smatraju se povratnicima. Prijave će se primati uobičajenim redoslijedom po principu "tko prvi , njegovo". * Ako se više od 50% novih natjecatelja prijavi prije nego što se preostalih 50% mjesta popuni povratnicima, daljnje prijave se prihvaćaju uobičajenim redoslijedom za nove natjecatelje i povratnike u isto vrijeme. * Ako mjesta osigurana za nove natjecatelje ne popune novi natjecatelji dva tjedna prije zatvaranja registracija, preostala mjesta, do ograničenja natjecatelja, bit će prihvaćena od registriranih povratnika. items.information: [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce the first Polokwane competition of 2024! This competition has a focus on holding popular events to give newer competitors an easy oppurtunity to start competing with the rest of the South African cubing community. The competition is open to **anyone** who knows how to solve a cube! Whether you take 20 seconds or 5 minutes to solve the 3x3 we will be happy to have you! ## Newcomers and returners This competition will recognise both a newcomer and experienced competitor podium across all the events. Be sure to stick around for the chance to meet and compete with other cubers! ##### ALL NEW COMPETITORS If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate) so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct. Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee. If you need a puzzle before the competition, check out www.speedcubes.co.za, www.cubeco.co.za, or https://cubestuff.co.za/ to order your puzzles before the comp. ## Volunteers We will require volunteers to support with running, judging and scrambling on the day. We will demonstrate the process for these duties during the new competitor tutorial, and encourage everyone to get involved. You also do not have to be a competitor to volunteer! If you are a parent, family member, or friend of a competitor, please do not hesitate to volunteer if you would like to help the competition run smoothly. ## About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out, please [get in touch.](https://cubingza.org/contact) We are particularly looking for help with communications, and graphic design.

items.name: DFW Megacomp 2024
items.information: This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will prioritize new competitors for registration, and returning competitors will be accepted after. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. **New competitors registration will be accepted based on the following:** * The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * If greater than 25% of new competitors register, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If less than 25% of new competitors register before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Returning competitors may still register at any point during the registration period, but their registration will be accepted based on the following:** * The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * If 25% of spots are filled by new competitors, returning competitors will then be accepted on a first come, first serve basis. * If 25% of spots are not filled by new competitors by registration close two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. --- As the month of March is WCA Newcomer Month, 25% of the competitor limit will be reserved for first-time competitors or competitors who's first competition is in 2024. More information can be found on the [WCA Newcomer Month tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#36408-wca-newcomer-month). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGhZIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--392ac2f0728e8e69ef497494e33b38b6b56bc2f4/565a7d59-6eb6-4b27-af6a-ad3bd4963ec0.png) # ***NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR DRINK IS PERMITTED IN THE VENUE.*** - Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#35850-competitor-information) tab before the competition. - Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition. Please note that the [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. Day 1 Events: 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, Clock, Pyraminx Day 2 Events: 3x3x3 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Megaminx, Square-1 This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/). items.information: ## [FR] ### Série Nouveaux Venus à Montréal 2024 Un week-end, deux compétitions! Nous organisons cette série de compétitions sur deux jours dans le cadre du **Mois des Nouveaux Venus de la WCA**. 30% des places seront réservées aux nouveaux venus (voir **Mois des Nouveaux Venus de la WCA** au bas de cette page pour plus d'informations). Vous pouvez choisir entre [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealA2024) (samedi) et [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealB2024) (dimanche). Ces compétitions sont identiques à l'exception du jour où elles se déroulent. Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à ***une seule*** de ces deux compétitions. ***Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plus qu'une de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée***. C'est une excellente occasion pour les nouveaux venus de participer à certaines ou à toutes les épreuves de 3x3x3 cube, de 2x2x2 cube, de pyraminx, de skewb et de 3x3x3 cube à une main! De plus, dans le cadre du mois des nouveaux venus de la WCA, nous aurons des prix spéciaux et des initiatives pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou vous inscrire à notre [liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ## [EN] ### Nouveaux Venus à Montréal 2024 Series One weekend, two competitions! We are running this two-day competition series as part of **WCA Newcomer Month**. 30% of spots will be reserved for newcomers (see **WCA Newcomer Month 2024** near the bottom of this page for more information). You can choose between [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealA2024) (Saturday) or [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealB2024) (Sunday). These competitions are identical except for the day they take place. You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** This is a great opportunity for newcomers to compete in some, or all of the 3x3x3 cube, 2x2x2 cube, pyraminx, skewb and 3x3x3 cube one-handed events! Plus, as part of WCA Newcomer Month we will have special prizes and initiatives for first-time competitors. ### Registration Reminders You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or join our [mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

To tekmovanje je vključeno v uraden WCA mesec novincev 2024. **Pri prijavah je 50% mest rezerviranih za novince.** Za novince se štejejo tisti tekmovalci, ki so še brez WCA ID-ja ali imajo WCA ID z začetkom 2024. Za povratnike se štejejo tisti tekmovalci, ki imajo WCA ID iz leta 2023 ali prej. Vsi tekmovalci morajo še vedno upoštevati vse zahteve za prijavo, da se njihova prijava šteje za popolno. ##### Prijave bodo sprejete na naslednji način: - 50% mest določenih z omejitvijo tekmovalcev je rezerviranih za novince. - Na začetku je 50% mest določenih z omejitvijo tekmovalcev na voljo za povratnike. Prijave bodo sprejete po običajnem redu - po vrstnem redu, kot bodo izpolnjeni vsi pogoji. - Če se prijavi več kot 50% novincev preden se zapolni preostalih 50% mest s povratniki, se nadaljnje prijave sprejemajo po običajnem redu za novince in povratnike hkrati. - Če novinci ne zapolnijo rezerviranih mest pred koncem prijav, dva tedna pred tekmovanjem, bodo preostala mesta zapolnjena s povratniki na čakalni listi do zapolnitve mest. items.information: ## [FR] ### Série Nouveaux Venus à Montréal 2024 Un week-end, deux compétitions! Nous organisons cette série de compétitions sur deux jours dans le cadre du **Mois des Nouveaux Venus de la WCA**. 30% des places seront réservées aux nouveaux venus (voir **Mois des Nouveaux Venus de la WCA** au bas de cette page pour plus d'informations). Vous pouvez choisir entre [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealA2024) (samedi) et [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealB2024) (dimanche). Ces compétitions sont identiques à l'exception du jour où elles se déroulent. Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à ***une seule*** de ces deux compétitions. ***Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plus qu'une de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée***. C'est une excellente occasion pour les nouveaux venus de participer à certaines ou à toutes les épreuves de 3x3x3 cube, de 2x2x2 cube, de pyraminx, de skewb et de 3x3x3 cube à une main! De plus, dans le cadre du mois des nouveaux venus de la WCA, nous aurons des prix spéciaux et des initiatives pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Vous devez vous inscrire et payer les frais d'inscription avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada](https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou vous inscrire à notre [liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques. ## [EN] ### Nouveaux Venus à Montréal 2024 Series One weekend, two competitions! We are running this two-day competition series as part of **WCA Newcomer Month**. 30% of spots will be reserved for newcomers (see **WCA Newcomer Month 2024** near the bottom of this page for more information). You can choose between [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealA2024) (Saturday) or [Nouveaux Venus à Montréal B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NouveauxVenusaMontrealB2024) (Sunday). These competitions are identical except for the day they take place. You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these two competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** This is a great opportunity for newcomers to compete in some, or all of the 3x3x3 cube, 2x2x2 cube, pyraminx, skewb and 3x3x3 cube one-handed events! Plus, as part of WCA Newcomer Month we will have special prizes and initiatives for first-time competitors. ### Registration Reminders You must register and pay the registration fee before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or join our [mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.name: Graz Open 2024
items.information: ##### *English version is below* ​ #### **Deutsch:** ​ Speedcubing ist wieder zurück in Graz! Elf Jahre nach der letzten Competition freuen wir uns Graz Open 2024 als offizielles WCA Turnier anzukündigen. ​ Die Speedcubing Competition wird von Thomas Pucher, Fabian Staber und Felix Strasser organisiert sowie von Viktor Kalmar und Pranjal Khan delegiert. Die Competiton findet im Herzen von Graz am Campus Alte Technik der Technischen Universität Graz statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. ​ Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können, den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden, solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! ​ Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. ​ ​ Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! ​ ----- ​ #### **English:** ​ Speedcubing is back in Graz! Eleven years after the last competition, we are pleased to announce the Graz Open 2024 as an official WCA tournament. ​ The Speedcubing Competition is organized by Thomas Pucher, Fabian Staber and Felix Strasser and delegated by Viktor Kalmar and Pranjal Khan. The competition will take place in the heart of Graz at the Campus Alte Technik of the Graz University of Technology. The results of this competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. ​ The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. ​ Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa1ZsIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--3c6e9fe6551a0ccb8658afed67be40e057fe6ac2/Mololoa_logo.png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al Mololoa Open 2024, la **segunda competencia oficial** en el hermoso estado de **Nayarit**!. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ###### English Welcome to Mololoa Open 2024, the **second official competition** in the beautiful state of **Nayarit**! This exciting and high-speed event will take place in the city of Tepic on Saturday, March 23, and Sunday, March 24, 2024. Mololoa Open 2024 will bring together cubers from across the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is recognized as an official event by the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.information: Diese Ausgabe der Rhein-Neckar-Competition **im Rahmen des offiziellen WCA Newcomer Month** richtet sich insbesondere an neue und unerfahrene Cuber, aber auch alle anderen Cuber sind herzlich willkommen. Wir freuen uns auf euch! Bei der Anmeldung werden 35% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmende reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmende gelten Teilnehmer:innen ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2024. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmende haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2023 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmenden müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. Weitere Informationen zur Annahme der Anmeldungen findet ihr im Tab "Newcomer Month". This edition of the Rhein-Neckar competitions is participating **in the official WCA Newcomer Month** and is especially directed towards new and inexperienced competitors. Of course every other cuber is welcome as well - we are looking forward to seeing all of you there! The registration process will reserve 35% of spots for new competitors. Sie ist ausserdem Partner-Competition vom "10 Johr Wiler Würfelfäst 2024". Bitte beachte, dass du nur an einem der beiden Wettbewerbe teilnehmen kannst. Wenn du dich für beide Wettbewerbe anmeldest, so zählt nur die erste Anmeldung und wir werden die zweite (spätere) Anmeldung unverzüglich löschen. Bei der Anmeldung werden 50% der Plätze für neue Teilnehmende reserviert. Als neue Teilnehmende gelten Teilnehmer:innen ohne WCA-ID oder mit einer WCA-ID aus dem Jahr 2024. Wiederkehrende Teilnehmende haben eine WCA-ID, die aus dem Jahr 2023 oder früher stammt. Alle Teilnehmenden müssen weiterhin alle Registrierungsanforderungen erfüllen, damit ihre Registrierung als vollständig gilt. Weitere Informationen zur Annahme der Anmeldungen findet ihr im Tab "Newcomer Month". engl. This edition "Wiler Würfelfäst für Afänger 2024" is participating **in the official WCA Newcomer Month** and is especially directed towards new and inexperienced competitors. It is also a partner competition of the "10 Johr Wiler Würfelfäst 2024". Please note that you can only compete in one of the two competitions. If you register for both competitions, only the first registration will be valid and we will immediately delete the second (later) registration. The registration process will reserve 50% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc1pYIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--74c131fe8cea25de98f45eaf2ad595e8b8eaf220/SCC%20x%20Newcomer%20Month%20-%20840x1080.png) ## Ajax 3x3x3 Newcomers Series One day, three competitions! We are running this one-day competition series as part of **WCA Newcomer Month**. 40% of spots will be reserved for newcomers (see **WCA Newcomer Month 2024** near the bottom of this page for more information). You can choose between [Ajax 3x3x3 Newcomers A](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax3x3x3NewcomersA2024), [Ajax 3x3x3 Newcomers B](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax3x3x3NewcomersB2024) or [Ajax 3x3x3 Newcomers C](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Ajax3x3x3NewcomersC2024)! These competitions are identical except for the time of day they take place (morning, afternoon or evening). You will only be able to compete in ***one*** of these three competitions. ***Attempting to register for more than one of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted.*** This is a great opportunity for newcomers to compete in 3x3x3 Cube – the maximum-allowed top-75% of competitors will advance to the second round! Plus, as part of WCA Newcomer Month we will have special prizes and initiatives for first-time competitors. ### Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. Please see the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

This competition is catered to all speedcubing newcomers and we welcome you to register for this competition! - Bay Area Speedcubin' is proud to partner with [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) and [CubersLive](https://www.facebook.com/CubersLive) to bring another competition to Northern California with a **focus on the live-stream and first-time competitor experience!** - This competition will be testing the new revolutionary score-taking technology, **TimeBase!** We will be using traditional scorecards but will be offering a brand-new, paperless scoretaking experience for all registered competitors! - This competition will be running a **Stationary Solve Station** set-up! - *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.* - We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. # Competitors can bring 1 guest for free to the competition! If they would like to bring a 2nd or more guests, we are charging $5 per extra guest via paypal at the front desk. Spectators not associated with the competition may still pay the $5 fee to attend and watch the competition up close and personal!

items.name: Big Cubes Athens 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc0ZpIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d2ad4e4f29cfeee447dd4662438ee1c08da476ee/image.png) Mετά τη συναρπαστική πορεία του 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024' η δράση συνεχίζεται με τον επόμενο διαγωνισμό της σειράς, αυτή τη φορά με έμφαση στα μεγάλα παζλ! Καλωσορίζουμε τους παίκτες στο δεύτερο μέρος αυτής της συναρπαστικής περιπέτειας, όπου τα παζλ υψηλής δυσκολίας θα κλέψουν την παράσταση. Από τon 4x4x4, μέχρι τoν 7x7x7. Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι σχεδιασμένος να δοκιμάσει τις δεξιότητες και την υπομονή των πιο έμπειρων cubers. Μην χάσετε την ευκαιρία να δείτε και να συμμετάσχετε σε αυτό το θέαμα δεξιοτεχνίας και αντοχής, όπου το μέγεθος και η πολυπλοκότητα πραγματικά μετράνε. Ετοιμάστε τους κύβους σας για μια ακόμα πρόκληση στον κόσμο του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) After the exciting run of 'Athens Cubing Starter Pack 2024' the action continues with the next competition in the series, this time with an emphasis on big puzzles! We welcome players to the second part of this thrilling adventure, where high-difficulty puzzles will steal the show. From the impressive 4x4x4s to the complex 7x7x7s and other equally challenging sizes, this competition is designed to test the skills and patience of the most experienced cubers. Don't miss the opportunity to witness and participate in this spectacle of dexterity and endurance, where size and complexity truly matter. Prepare your cubes for another challenge in the world of cubing! Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbjVvIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--cbc38cf4292d3456b348ed1c98f9220e790a124c/565a7d59-6eb6-4b27-af6a-ad3bd4963ec0%5B1%5D.png) 「東海チャレンジ2024」の全ての大会は、WCAの「ニューカマー月間2024」(WCA Newcomer Month 2024)の適用大会です。 詳細は、[WCA Newcomer Month](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeAlpha2024#40601-wca-newcomer-month) のタブをご覧ください。 ### WCAシリーズ大会 「東海チャレンジ2024」はWCAシリーズ大会です。 WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 このページは「東海チャレンジ2024」の「アルファ大会」のページです。 ・ Tokai Challenge Alpha 2024(**本ページでは「アルファ大会」と表記**) ・ [Tokai Challenge Beta 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeBeta2024) (**本ページでは「ベータ大会」と表記**) ・ [Tokai Challenge Gamma 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeGamma2024)(**本ページでは「ガンマ大会」と表記**) 各大会の種目、ラウンド数、開場時刻、定員は以下の通りです。 ・アルファ大会：3x3x3 のみ 1 ラウンド 開場時刻 9:00 定員40名 ・ベータ大会：3x3x3 のみ 1 ラウンド 開場時刻 13:00 定員40名 ・ガンマ大会：クロック のみ 2 ラウンド 開場時刻 16:00 定員20名 ガンマ大会終了後にTSCスペースを開催します。 ・スピードキューバーのためのオフ会です。 ・交流、親睦、情報交換を楽しんでください。 ・18:30開始、20:00終了を予定しています。 ### 注意 注意１．来場時刻について アルファ大会については、時間厳守でお願いします。 ベータ大会、ガンマ大会については、時間に余裕をもって会場にお越しください。 競技の進行によっては前倒しで進めることがあります。 注意２．受付について 受付はありません。 必ず事前にご自身の役割（競技者、ジャッジ、スクランブラ）を確認してください。 会場に到着しましたら、速やかに観客席に着席してください。 ### 「東海チャレンジ」のコンセプト 「東海チャレンジ」では、できるだけ多くの方々にWCA大会にチャレンジしていただきたいと思っています。 アルファ大会、ベータ大会、ガンマ大会の違いについて簡単に説明します。 １．アルファ大会とベータ大会 「東海チャレンジ」では、WCA大会初心者の方、WCA大会未経験の方に、WCA大会にチャレンジして頂きたいと思っています。 アルファ大会とベータ大会は、3x3x3のみの1種目、1ラウンドです。 ぜひWCA大会にチャレンジし、大会の雰囲気、大会の楽しさを味わってください。 ２．ガンマ大会 「東海チャレンジ」では、3x3x3以外の種目についてもチャレンジしていただきたいと思っています。 ガンマ大会では、クロックを2ラウンドで開催します。 クロックが好きな方、クロックに自信がある方、クロックで腕試ししたい方は、ぜひチャレンジしてください。 ### 競技参加者以外の来場要件 **限られた会場広さで、できるだけ多くの競技者に参加できるようにしてもらうため、同伴者及び見学者に制限を設けております。** 観客席に着席できない場合は、見学をお断りすることがあります。席を譲り合い、空いている席が無いように詰めてお掛けください。 ### サポーター募集 より継続的かつ安定的にスピードキュービングチャレンジをするためには、大会を成立させるための運営側に人手が必要となります。そこで運営に興味のある競技者や、競技者の保護者の方に「サポーター」として活躍していただきたく思います。サポーターの役割は大会当日の会場設営、受付、呼び出し、記録入力・印刷、机消毒、撤収作業等になります。サポーターご自身の競技やお子さまの活躍の応援に影響の出ない範囲内でご協力していただきます。 後日サポーターの募集のご案内をさせていただきます。 ### 主催団体TSCとは 東海スピードキュービングコミュニティ（以下 TSC）は、スピードキューバー向けのオフ会「TSCスペース」およびスピードキューバー向けの自己研鑽の場「TSCスペース自習室」をそれぞれ月1回を目標に開催しています。 また、SCJ大会を年4回を目標に、WCA大会を年1回を目標に開催しています。 現在、運営スタッフを募集中です。 一緒にWCA大会やTSCスペースを開催しましょう！ All the competitions in "Tokai Challenge 2024" are applied to the WCA Newcomer Month 2024. For more information, please see the [WCA Newcomer Month](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeAlpha2024#40601-wca-newcomer-month) tab. ### WCA Series Competitions Tokai Challenge 2024 is a WCA series competition. WCA series Competitions are a series of multiple competitions, and you can participate in **only one** of them. If you apply for more than one series, only the one with the earliest application date will be valid, and the others will be invalid. This page shows Tokai Challenge Alpha 2024. Tokai Challenge Alpha 2024 (**In this page, called "Alpha "**) [Tokai Challenge Beta 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeBeta2024) (**In this page, called "Beta"**) [Tokai Challenge Gamma 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiChallengeGamma2024)(**In this page, called "Gamma"**) The events, number of rounds, opening time, and maximum number of players for each event are as follows: Alpha : 3x3x3 only, 1 round, open at 9:00, capacity 40 Beta : 3x3x3 only, 1 round, open at 13:00, capacity 40 Gamma : Clock only, 2 rounds, open at 16:00, capacity 20 TSC space will be held after the Gamma competition. This is an off-line meeting for speedcubers. Please enjoy socializing, friendship, and exchanging information. The event starts from 18:30 to 20:00. ### Cautions Caution 1: About the time of arrival Please be on-time arrival for the Alpha. For Beta and Gamma, please arrive at the venue well in advance. Depending on the progress of the competition, it may be moved ahead of schedule. Caution 2: Reception We have no reception desk. Please make sure to confirm your role (competitor, judge, scrambler) in advance. Upon arrival at the venue, please be seated at the spectator's seats as soon as possible. ### Concept of "Tokai Challenge" In the "Tokai Challenge," we want to encourage as many people as possible to try out for the WCA competitions. The following is a brief explanation of the differences between the Alpha, Beta, and Gamma. 1.Alpha and Beta The Tokai Challenge is intended to challenge those who are new to WCA competitions and those who have no experience in WCA competitions. The Alpha and Beta are 3x3x3 only, one event, one round. We encourage you to try the WCA competitions and experience the atmosphere and the fun of the competitions. 2.Gamma In the "Tokai Challenge," we would like to challenge you to compete in events other than 3x3x3. In the Gamma , Clock event will be held in two rounds. If you like Clock, are confident with Clock, or want to test your skills with Clock, please take the challenge. ### Requirements for non-competitors **In order to allow as many competitors as possible to participate in the limited size of the venue, we have set restrictions on accompanying persons and visitors.** If you are unable to be seated in the spectator seating area, we may refuse to allow you to observe. items.information: **Newcomers Costa Rica 2024** Es la segunda competencia del nuevo año 2024. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia official de la World Cube Association. La competencia es abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, el registro esta habilitado desde la página oficial de la WCA. No es necesario tener experiencia, pero los competidores deben estar conocer los Reglamentos El acceso a invitados y espectadores será gratuita. Esta competencia participa en el Mes oficial de recién llegados de la WCA 2024. El proceso de registro dará prioridad a los nuevos competidores para el registro, y los competidores que regresen serán aceptados después. Se considera que los nuevos competidores no tienen ID de la WCA o tienen una ID de la WCA de 2024. Se considera que los competidores que regresan tienen una ID de la WCA de 2023 o anterior. Todos los competidores aún deben seguir todos los requisitos de registro para que su registro se considere completo. Los competidores que ya han competido se pueden registrar en cualquier momento durante el período de registro, pero su registro será aceptado según lo siguiente : * El primer 50% de las plazas, según lo definido por el límite de competidores, está reservado para nuevos competidores. * Si el 50% de los lugares están ocupados por nuevos competidores, los competidores que regresan serán aceptados por orden de llegada. * Si el 50% de los lugares no están ocupados por nuevos competidores antes del cierre de registro dos semanas antes de la competencia, se aceptarán los lugares restantes, hasta el límite de competidores, de los competidores registrados que regresan. _____ **English version** **Newcomers Costa Rica 2024 Is a second competition of the new year 2024. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. The competition is open to all competitors of all nationalities. Registration is available on the WCA website. No experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors should be familiar with the WCA Regulations The competition is free to spectators and guests. This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will prioritize new competitors for registration, and returning competitors will be accepted after. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Returning competitors may still register at any point during the registration period, but their registration will be accepted based on the following: The first 50% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. If 50% of spots are filled by new competitors, returning competitors will then be accepted on a first come, first serve basis. If 50% of spots are not filled by new competitors by registration close two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

venue.name: Private residence, Bryanston, Johannesburg
venue.details: Details will be sent to registered competitors.

items.information: ## This is not a normal competition We won't be holding any normal events. This competition is entirely focused on blindfolded events,. If you have not competed before, this may not be the best experience for your first competition. Sign up at [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) to get notifications for other competitions in your province. **Please be quiet**. These events can require immense focus, so as the name of the competition suggests, competitors and spectators must remain quiet to ensure fair and equal conditions for all competitors. Those who continually make noise will be asked to leave without refund. ## Venue The venue is in a private venue in Bryanston. Access for all competitors and guests need to be arranged in advance. Failure to do so will result in you or your guests being denied access to the venue. There is limited parking that needs to be arranged in advance. **All competitors** must please provide the following information in the comments of their registration: 1. If you will be arriving by car, please provide registration number. 2. If you will be getting a lift with someone, please provide the name of the person you will be getting a lift with. 3. If using an Uber or other transport, please indicate this. Once you have provided this information, you will be given the exact address. ## Guests Competitors may bring only one guest due to venue constraints. If a competitor is bringing a guest, then they must provide the full name and surname. ## About CubingZA Competitions in South Africa have exploded since the end of COVID, and interest is only getting stronger. [CubingZA](https://cubingza.org) is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Está é uma competição que não terá o Cubo 3x3x3 como uma de suas modalidades. **ATENÇÃO:** Devido ao tamanho do local da competição, apenas um acompanhante será permitido por competidor. Façamos a competição ser possível para todos os competidores! --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** This competition will not have the 3x3x3 Cube as one of its events. **ATTENTION:** Due to the size of the competition's venue, only one guest will be allowed per competitor. Please do not bring more guests than the allowed quantity, let's make the competition possible for all competitors!

Вся информация и новости по соревнованиям будет в нашем инстаграме. Организаторы не несут ответственности за утерю личных вещей. Мы настоятельно рекомендуем использовать на головоломках отличительные отметки (Внутри кубика или под крышкой детальки) , по которым их легко может идентифицировать владелец. После оплаты взноса ваша фамилия появится на сайте. Это означает, что ваша заявка принята. Если вы не оплатили взнос, то примерно за 1 неделю до и непосредственно перед закрытием регистрации вы получите письмо с напоминанием о необходимости оплатить взнос для подтверждения своего участия. Обязательно проверяйте свой ящик и папку СПАМ. Если вы не оплатите взнос, то Ваша заявка не будет принята. Если Вы подали заявку и оплатили взнос, но в течении 2-х рабочих дней ее не подтвердили, сразу обратитесь к организаторам (не считая выходные дни). ##### В день соревнований участнику при себе нужно иметь документ удостоверяющий личность. --- Біздің Instagram парақшамызды қараңыз (https://instagram.com/speedcubing_ksf?utm_medium=copy_link). Байқау туралы барлық ақпарат пен жаңалықтар біздің instagram желісінде болады. 1.Жеке заттар жоғалуына ұйымдастырушылар жауапты емес. Пазлдарда ерекше белгілерді пайдалануды ұсынамыз (текшенің ішінде немесе бөліктің мұқабасының астында), белгі арқылы иесі оларды оңай анықтауға мүмкіндік береді. Төлемді төлегеннен кейін сіздің аты-жөніңіз сайтта пайда болады. Бұл сіздің өтінішіңіз қабылданғанын білдіреді. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемеген болсаңыз, онда тіркеуден шамамен 1 апта бұрын және тіркеуді жаппас бұрын, сіз өзіңіздің қатысуыңызды растау үшін жарнаны төлеу қажеттілігі туралы ескерту хат аласыз. Міндетті түрде Жәшік пен СПАМ қалтасын тексеріңіз. Егер сіз жарнаны төлемесеңіз, онда сіздің өтініміңіз қабылданбайды. Егер сіз өтінім беріп, жарнаны төлеген болсаңыз, бірақ оны 2 жұмыс күні ішінде растамаған болса, дереу Ұйымдастырушыларға хабарласыңыз (демалыс күндерін есептемегенде). ##### Жарыс күні қатысушыда өзімен бірге жеке басын куәландыратын құжат болуы қажет. --- Please see our Instagram account (https://www.instagram.com/cubing.kz?igsh=MTlycGkxYnd5MnF6aA==). All information and news on the competition will be on our instagram. The organizers are not responsible for the loss of personal belongings. We strongly recommend using distinctive marks on the puzzles (Inside the cube or under the cover of the part), by which the owner can easily identify them. After paying the fee, your name will appear on the site. This means that your application has been accepted. If you have not paid the fee, you will receive an email reminding you to pay the fee to confirm your participation approximately 1 week before and immediately before the registration closes. Be sure to check your inbox and SPAM folder. If you do not pay the fee, your application will not be accepted. If you submitted an application and paid the fee, but did not confirm it within 2 working days, immediately contact the organizers (excluding weekends). ##### On the day of the competition, the participant must have an identity document with him.

items.information: #Please check the schedule to find possible time slots. Please indicate in the registration comments what timeslot you would prefer to compete in. #Competitors may register for 3x3 and up to one of the following events: 2x2, Skewb, Pyraminx, Megaminx, Clock, or Square-1. Competitors may not register for more than two events, and if they register for two events, one of them must be 3x3. - On-site registration will be the expo's $30 entrance fee plus $5 paid to us on the spot. - Specify the time you would prefer to compete in the registration comments. We will email everyone their time slot once registration has closed. Time slots will be determined based on a first-come first-serve basis. If your desired time slot is full, we will reach out via email and ask for another time slot. - If you would like to modify your events you are registered for, please contact us through the contact form for this competition and we will modify your registration accordingly. *In a catastrophic event where the event will be compromised and cancelled, a full refund shall be offered to all competitors, in contrast to the typical 95% registration refunds.* ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcmhuIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--26e7dd6ac4909eb7484f685f1f010ff228529aaf/main.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcUJOIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--573fdf538a21acdaa5aaf068feb5551af8f5c1df/Logo_big.png) #This is an expo first! We will have things planned between 3x3 groups that isn't competing! - [West Coast Cubing LLC](https://www.facebook.com/WestCoastCubingLLC) presents another Bay Area Speedcubin' competition! - *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.* - We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. - Spectators will have to pay entry to the expo. Tickets may be purchased ahead of time at the [EVO Sports Expo website](https://www.evosportsglobal.com/evo-store/p/santa-clara-evo-expo-ticket) for $30, or in person the day of. - We urge competitors with spectators (especially minors) to not register for the first timeslot; however, a guardian (with a spectator ticket purchased) will be able to enter early with the competitors, it will be more straightforward to register for any timeslot but the first.

venue.name: [Kirstenhof Primary School](https://goo.gl/maps/ibUsNtD2otafVyrp9)

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce a new Cape Town competition for 2024. This comp will focus on the original cube, the **3x3x3**, and the varying ways to solve it - with **two hands, one-handed, blindfolded**, and in the **fewest moves**; and we will round out the events with some **2x2, 4x4,** and **Megaminx**. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** make payment by buying a ticket. Please see **Registration Requirements** below." ### SPECTATORS Competitors are welcome to bring 2 spectators with them. Please let us know if you need to accommodate more spectators. ### VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ### SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbU10IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--03db2d12875f7b21e073b29649b48a5bc813b0e2/image.png) A big thanks to [Speedcubes](https://www.speedcubes.co.za/) who are sponsoring vouchers as a part of the prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to try out and buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. ### LUCKY DRAW During prize-giving after 3x3 Finals on Sunday, we will be having a Lucky Draw for two winners to receive R250 Speedcubes.co.za vouchers each with free shipping on their order! If you needed another reason to stick around and watch 3x3 Finals other than the amazing speed of some of Africa's top speedcubers, maybe you could be one of the lucky winners and walk away with some free cubes or apparel courtesy of our local speedcubing store. #### About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. In 2024, we are anticipating being able to host one competition every season in each of the cities of Cape Town, Johannesburg, and Durban, as well as other regular events in Pretoria, Bloemfontein, Limpopo, and more! If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to bring competitive speedcubing to the country, please [get in touch](https://cubingza.org/contact).

items.name: Trondheim Spring 2024
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Trondheim Spring 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 50kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2024#40829-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Trondheim Spring 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 50 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrondheimSpring2024#40829-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information. **N.B.:** Due to a Swedish public holiday (1st of May), the first event will start at **3:40 PM** - *not* 5:40 PM as usual.
