items.information: ### WCAシリーズ大会 「東海大会2024」はWCAシリーズ大会です。 WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 このページは「東海大会2024」の「AM大会」のページです。 ・ Tokai Open AM 2024(**本ページでは「AM大会」と表記**) ・ [Tokai Open PM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiOpenPM2024) (**本ページでは「PM大会」と表記**) 各大会の種目、ラウンド数、開場時刻、定員は以下の通りです。 ・AM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 1ラウンド、3x3x3 片手 2ラウンド 開場時刻 9:00 定員72名 ・PM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 1ラウンド、5x5x5 キューブ 2ラウンド 開場時刻 13:30 定員72名 ### 来場時刻 AM大会については、必ず受付時間内にお越しください。 PM大会については、開場時刻の13:30までは会場に入れません。なるべく13:30から13:50の間にお越しください。 ### 参加費の支払い方法 参加費は受付時にお支払いください。 支払い方法は現金のみです。 ### 同伴、見学について 同伴は競技者一人につき**2名まで**とします。申込時に同伴者数を入力してください。 大会見学希望の方へ。 観客席に僅かですが空席が生じることが分かりましたので、見学希望者の方はメールに、以下内容の記載をお願いします。 送信先：comp@cubing.nagoya メールタイトル： 【WCA東海大会】見学希望 メール本文： ・希望人数：〇名 ・全員の氏名：例 山田太郎、山田次郎 ・見学したい大会：AM、PM なお、先着順となりますので、ご了承ください。 **連絡無しの見学は絶対におやめください。** ### 当日スタッフ募集 大会を円滑に進めるために、実行委員以外のスタッフを募集します。当日スタッフにはジャッジ、スクランブラ、ランナーにご協力頂きたいと思います。 後日、当日スタッフ募集についてご案内します。 ### 主催団体「TSC」とは 東海スピードキュービングコミュニティ（以下 TSC）は、スピードキューバー向けのオフ会「TSCスペース」およびスピードキューバー向けの自己研鑽の場「TSCスペース自習室」を開催しています。 現在、運営スタッフを募集中です。 一緒にWCA大会やTSCスペースを開催しましょう！ ### WCA Series Competitions Tokai Open 2024 is a WCA series competition. WCA series competitions are a series of multiple competitions, and you can participate in **only one** of them. If you apply for more than one in the same series, only the one with the earliest application time will be valid, and the others will be invalid. This page shows Tokai Open AM 2024. Tokai Open AM 2024 (**In this page, called "AM"**) [Tokai Open PM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TokaiOpenPM2024) (**In this page, called "PM"**) The events, number of rounds, opening time, and maximum number of players for each event are as follows: AM : 3x3x3 Cube 1 round, 3x3x3 One-Handed 2 rounds, open at 9:00, limit of competitors 72 PM : 3x3x3 Cube 1 round, 5x5x5 Cube 2 rounds, open at 13:30, limit of competitors 72 ### Time of arrival For the AM competition, please be sure to arrive during the reception time. For the PM competition, you will not be allowed to enter the venue until 13:30, the time the doors open. Please arrive between 13:30 and 13:50 if possible. ### How to pay the participation fee Please pay the participation fee at the reception. Payment must be made in cash only. ### Requirements for non-competitors Each competitor may bring up to two people. Please declare the number of guests at registration form. For those who wish to visit. We would like to release a few empty seats in the spectators area, so if you wish to visit, please send us an e-mail with the following information. Send to: comp@cubing.nagoya Mail title: [WCA Tokai Open] visiting request Mail body: Number of people: Name of all visitor: e.g. Taro Yamada, Jiro Yamada Competition to be visited: AM, PM Seats will be available on a first-come, first-served basis with this email. **Please do not visit without notification. ** ### Staff Wanted on the Day In order to ensure the smooth running of the event, we are looking for staff members who are not members of the organizer. We would like to have judges, scramblers, and runners on staff on the day of the event. We will inform you about the recruitment of staff on the day of the event at a later date. ### About TSC, the host organization Tokai Speedcubing Community (hereinafter referred to as "TSC") holds "TSC Space," an off-line meeting for speedcubers, and "TSC Space Study Room," a place for self-improvement for speedcubers. We are currently looking for an administrative staff member. Let's organize WCA competitions and TSC space together!

items.information: ### 대회 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대회 참가가 불가능합니다. ### 참가 확정 / 대기 명단은 3일 내로 갱신되니, 참가 신청 이후 명단에서 본인의 이름을 확인해 주시기를 바랍니다. ### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ ### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist. ### Within 3 days of paying the registration fee, you should be able to see your name on either the competitor list or waitlist. ### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

items.name: Poções Geek 2024
items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Registration is open to any person, from any country. For the competition to run smoothly, by registering for an event, you agree to help as judge, scrambler or runner for this event (as it's said at WCA rules). This way, the competition turns out to be self-supported, and the activities are divided between all competitors, and not charging anyone in excess.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdWlFIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--43e30f5cc65d1df2973f94fb32cb7e25100b1ee1/New%20Project%20(3)%20(2).png) ###### Español ¡**Silence in Nayarit 2024**! La primera competencia oficial en Nayarit especializada en eventos silenciosos se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de Tepic el sábado 21 y domingo 22 de septiembre de 2024. Silence in Nayarit 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en los eventos oficiales más difíciles. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos demuestren sus habilidades. La competencia incluirá una ronda de 3x3x3 Team-Blind, un evento no oficial que promete ser muy emocionante. Además, esta competencia está reconocida oficialmente por la Asociación Mundial del Cubo (WCA). Por lo tanto, es importante que todos los competidores estén familiarizados con el reglamento de la WCA antes de la competencia. ###### English **Silence in Nayarit 2024**! The first official competition in Nayarit specialized in silent events will be held in the city of Tepic on Saturday, September 21, and Sunday, September 22, 2024. Silence in Nayarit 2024 will bring together cubers from all over the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in the most challenging official events. Whether you are a beginner or an experienced professional, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to demonstrate their abilities. The competition will include a 3x3x3 Team-Blind round, an unofficial event that promises to be very exciting. Additionally, this competition is officially recognized by the World Cube Association (WCA). Therefore, it is important that all competitors familiarize themselves with the WCA regulations before the competition.

items.name: Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw 2024
items.information: Zapraszamy na czwartą edycję zawodów Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw! W tym roku najlepsi polscy i zagraniczni speedcuberzy będą rywalizować w bardziej popularnych konkurencjach, choć nie zabraknie side'owych akcentów. Wydarzenie odbywa się w [Pałacu Kultury i Nauki](https://pkin.pl/) - jednym z najbardziej rozpoznawalnych miejsc w Polsce. Na zwycięzców czekają nagrody finansowe zapewnione przez [Fundację Szansa - Jesteśmy Razem](https://www.szansadlaniewidomych.org/). Turniej organizowany jest przez Fundację Szansa - Jesteśmy Razem wraz ze [Stowarzyszeniem Liga Niezwykłych](https://liganiezwyklych.pl/). Wydarzenie finansowane jest ze środków [Miasta Stołecznego Warszawy](https://um.warszawa.pl/) oraz [Mazowsza](https://mazowsze.waw.pl/). Marszałek województwa mazowieckiego [Adam Struzik](https://mazovia.pl/pl/bip/zarzad/sklad-zarzadu/adam-struzik.html) objął wydarzenie swoim patronatem. Na konkurencję **3x3x3 Najmniejsza liczba ruchów** obowiązuje oddzielny limit zawodników: **Najlepsze 30** osób według średniej (lub pojedynczego wyniku) na podstawie zawodników zarejestrowanych. --- We invite you to the fourth edition of the Szansa Cubing Open Warsaw competition! This year, the best Polish and international cubers will compete in the more popular events, though there will be some side events as well. The event will take place in the Palace of Culture and Science - one of the most recognizable buildings in Poland. Financial prizes for the winners are provided by the Chance Foundation - We Are Together. The tournament is organized by the Szansa Foundation - We Are Together along with the Stowarzyszenie Liga Niezwykłych. The event is funded by the City of Warsaw and Mazovia. The Marshal of the Mazowieckie Voivodeship, Adam Struzik, has taken the event under his patronage. For **FMC** event there is a seperate competitor limit: **Top 30** people classified by mean (otherwise single) according to the psych sheet of the registered competitors. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzYwNDksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c6e10f78d18761d23d665d7aa7448d5615b396be/unnamed.jpg)

items.name: Autumn Cubing Reunion Athens A - 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBczJJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6d41a95dbcd2b6c177ccb028ad973065c128a8aa/reunion%202024.jpg) [](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcnA1IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--07e81cdd5b508271bf1d27c0c873b462bead0340/image.png) **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το Α μέρος σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **μόνο σε έναν από τους δύο**. Ο 3x3 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα 4x4 και Clock ή 2x2 και OH επιθυμείτε. Μετά από τις διακοπές θα βρεθούμε ξανά για τον πρώτο διαγωνισμό της νέας σεζόν! Ελάτε να περάσουμε όμορφα για ακόμα μία φορά στον γνωστό πλέον χώρο του Rubicon. Σας περιμένουμε στο **Autumn Cubing Reunion Athens 2024 - A. ** Αγωνίσματα Α' διαγωνισμού: * 3x3 * 4x4 * Clock Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) **Note:** This competition is part A of a series of two competitions. You can participate in **only one of the two**. 3x3 is in both contests so choose carefully which day or which of 4x4 and Clock or 2x2 and OH you prefer. After the holidays we will meet again for the first competition of the new season! Come and have a good time once again at the famous Rubicon venue. We are waiting for you in **Autumn Cubing Reunion Athens 2024 - A.** Competition Α events: * 3x3 * 4x4 * Clock Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.name: Ottawa Favourites 2024
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## [EN] ### Registration Reminders Since this is a "favourites" competition, **you may choose at most four (4) events**. You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video expains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). Please see tabs for more information about the competition. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ## [FR] ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Comme il s'agit là d'une compétition de type "favoris", **vous pouvez choisir au maximum quatre (4) épreuves**. Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: **REGISTRO** A participação nesta competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: 1. Se inscrever através do site da WCA. A inscrição terá custo de R$ 35 e o pagamento deverá ser feito via PIX para a chave planeta.rio.open@gmail.com. O comprovante de pagamento deverá ser enviado para o mesmo email; 2. Escolher os eventos a serem registrados com cuidado após revisar as guias Eventos e Cronograma. Prestar atenção aos formatos das rodadas e seus cortes/limites; 3. Preencher o seguinte [formulário](https://forms.gle/CKRxrhXte6JPtWmq5) para facilitar o controle dos nomes dos competidores e acompanhantes por parte da equipe do Planetário envolvida com a organização; 4. Para obterem a entrada e permanência na competição, os **acompanhantes** deverão adquirir os ingressos na bilheteria do Planetário. Cada competidor terá direito a 2 acompanhantes grátis e mais dois pagando meia entrada (R$10), isso caso a inscrição seja realizada até dia 5 de setembro. Os demais acompanhantes, se houver, deverão pagar o valor inteiro do ingresso (R$20) para entrada. **Esta taxa é aplicada somente aos acompanhantes e deverá ser paga apenas nos dias da competição, não devendo ser feita junto a transferência PIX para o pagamento da inscrição**; 5. Para informações adicionais, verifique o site da WCA ou entre em contato com o organizador através do email planeta.rio.open@gmail.com, bem como o delegado por meio do email gmello@worldcubeassociation.org ou isoares@worldcubeassociation.org; 6. Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. **REGISTRATION** The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: 1. Register through the WCA website. The registration costs R$35 and must be paid via PIX transfer to planeta.rio.open@gmail.com. Proof of payment must be sent to the same email address; 2. Carefully choosing the events. Keep the rounds format, cutoffs and limits in mind; 3. Fill in the following [form](https://forms.gle/CKRxrhXte6JPtWmq5) to help keep track of competitor and guest names by the Planetarium team involved with the organization; 4. To gain entry and stay in the competition, **companions** must purchase tickets at the Planetarium box office. Each competitor will be entitled to 2 free companions and two more for half price (R$10), if registration is completed by September 5th. Other companions, if any, must pay the entire ticket price (R$20) for entry. **This fee is only applied to companions and must only be paid on the days of the competition, and must not be made together with the PIX transfer to pay for registration**; 5. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact the organizer via email, (planeta.rio.open@gmail.com), or the delegate ( gmello@worldcubeassociation.org or isoares@worldcubeassociation.org); 6. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.name: Sandnes Open 2024
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 170kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Sandnes Open 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 170 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition.

items.name: Autumn Cubing Reunion Athens B - 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBczZJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--c69345df7f1786044b7edebd81021dc575cf1952/reunion%202024.jpg) **Προσοχή:** Ο διαγωνισμός αυτός είναι το Α μέρος σειράς δύο διαγωνισμών. Μπορείτε να συμμετάσχετε **μόνο σε έναν από τους δύο**. Ο 3x3 είναι και στους δύο διαγωνισμούς οπότε διαλέξτε με προσοχή ποια μέρα ή πoιο από τα 4x4 και Clock ή 2x2 και OH επιθυμείτε. Μετά από τις διακοπές θα βρεθούμε ξανά για τον πρώτο διαγωνισμό της νέας σεζόν! Ελάτε να περάσουμε όμορφα για ακόμα μία φορά στον γνωστό πλέον χώρο του Rubicon. Σας περιμένουμε στο **Autumn Cubing Reunion Athens 2024 - B. ** Αγωνίσματα Β' διαγωνισμού: * 3x3 * 2x2 * 3x3 OH (Λύση με το ένα χέρι) Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στο σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) **Note:** This competition is part A of a series of two competitions. You can participate in **only one of the two**. 3x3 is in both contests so choose carefully which day or which of 4x4 and Clock or 2x2 and OH you prefer. After the holidays we will meet again for the first competition of the new season! Come and have a good time once again at the famous Rubicon venue. We are waiting for you in **Autumn Cubing Reunion Athens 2024 - B. ** Competition B events: * 3x3 * 2x2 * 3x3 OH (One Handed) Please read the following tab very carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered valid, the competitor should both register though the WCA site **AND** pay the registration fee as described in the nexts tabs. Please read the following tabs in detail to find all the necessary information.

items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information: Välkomna till Götalandsmästerskapet 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Götaland som kan vinna titlar och priser på Götalandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Gotalandsmasterskapet2024#43304-regionala-masterskap-2024-regional-championships-2024)". ----- Welcome to Götalandsmästerskapet 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Götaland can win titles and prizes at the Götaland Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeasociation.org/competitions/Gotalandsmasterskapet2024#43304-regionala-masterskap-2024-regional-championships-2024)". Es un honor recibirlos Boca del Río, con sus hermosas playas y su ameno ambiente, es el lugar perfecto para relajarse y disfrutar. Por lo tanto, es ideal para que los competidores puedan demostrar sus habilidades en esta disciplina. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) antes de la competencia. **English** Welcome to **Cangrejito Azul 2024**, the first competition held in Boca del Río, Veracruz! We are pleased to welcome competitors and enthusiasts from all over the country to celebrate this event, where you can enjoy this vibrant and welcoming city. It is an honor to host you in Boca del Río, with its beautiful beaches and pleasant atmosphere, the perfect place to relax and enjoy. Therefore, it is ideal for competitors to showcase their skills in this discipline. This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.name: Salonica Open 2024
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcytJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--6e34f6fe493b1bce264fb972ecff45845289d920/salonica%202024.jpg) Το Salonica Open 2024 είναι o μοναδικός επίσημος διαγωνισμός για το 2024 στη Θεσσαλονική... μην τον χάσετε... πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στην γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) The Salonica Open 2024 is the only official WCA competition so far in Thessaloniki (Salonica) in 2024... so don't miss it... Grab your cubes, get ready, read the rules, and come to the cubing celebration! Grab your cubes, study the regulations and attend the greek feast of cubing! items.name: Kyub sa Aga Masskara 2024
items.information: **US (English)** The Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee is thrilled to present the **Kyub sa Masskara 2024** competition series, two competitions held in one day—morning and afternoon, in celebration of the Masskara Festival in Bacolod City! This competition will be held in the morning, the afternoon competition can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024/register). Competitors **shall only compete in one of the two competitions**, either [Kyub sa Aga](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaAgaMasskara2024) or [Kyub sa Hapon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024). This is strictly implemented. We strongly encourage you to stay 'til the end of both competitions as there will be awards. All events in both competitions are the same and will consist of a single round. For more details about the competition, please refer to the tabs above. By registering, competitors and their guests—including but not limited to family members, friends, and guardians—acknowledge and agree that the organizing bodies, their personnel, and any associated individuals shall not be held liable for any harm or injury, loss of personal belongings or property, or emotional distress resulting from participation in this competition. Please be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) before participating in this event. *** **PH (Tagalog)** Ikinagagalag na hinahandog ng Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee ang **Kyub sa Masskara 2024** kompetisyong serye, dalawang kompetisyon na gaganapin sa isang araw—umaga at hapon, bilang pagdiriwang ng Masskara Festival sa Lungsod ng Bacolod! Ang kompetisyong ito ay magaganap sa umaga. Ang hapong edisyon ay makikita [dito](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024). Ang mga kalahok ay **dapat na makilahok sa isang kompetisyon lamang**, maaring [Kyub sa Aga](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaAgaMasskara2024) o [Kyub sa Hapon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024). Ito ay mahigpitang ipinapatupad. Ang lahat ng kategorya sa dalawang kompetisyon ay magkapareho at binubuo ng isang round lamang. Para sa karagdagang impormasyon sa kompetisyon, maaring i-klik ang mga tabs sa itaas. Sa pamamagitan ng pagrerehistro, ang mga kalahok at kanilang mga bisita—kabilang ngunit hindi limitado sa mga miyembro ng pamilya, kaibigan, at mga tagapag-alaga—ay kinikilala at sumasang-ayon na ang mga namamahalang katawan, kanilang mga tauhan, at anumang kaugnay na indibidwal ay hindi mananagot para sa anumang pinsala o sakuna, pagkawala ng personal na pag-aari o kagamitan, o emosyonal na pagkabalisa na resulta ng paglahok sa kompetisyon na ito. Maging pamilyar sa [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) bago makilahok sa kompetisyong ito. *** **PH (Hiligaynon)** Bugal nga gina-anunsyo Negros Speedcubers Organizing Committee ang **Kyub sa Masskara 2024**, duha ka kompetisyon nga gina hiwat sa isa ka adlaw—aga kag hapon, para i-selebrar ang maabot nga Masskara Festival sa syudad sang Bacolod. Hiliwaton ang kompetisyon nga ini sa aga. Ang hapon nga edisyon, makita [diri](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024). Sa mga maintra, **isa lang dapat ka kompetisyon ang intrahan**, pwede nga [Kyub sa Aga](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaAgaMasskara2024) ukon [Kyub sa Hapon](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KyubsaHaponMasskara2024). Ini ang strikto nga gina sunod. Ang tanan nga kategorya sa duha nga kompetisyon parehas lang kag ginalakipan sang isa ka round. Para sa mas madamo pa gid nga impormasyon, palihog i-klik ang mga tabs sa babaw. Paagi sa pagrehistro, ang mga maintra kag ang ila mga kaupod—lakip na apang indi limitado sa mga miyembro sang pamilya, abyan, kag mga tagabantay—nagasugot kag nagakilala nga ang mga nagadumala, ila mga personnel, kag bisan ano nga may kaangtanan nga mga indibidwal indi manabat para sa bisan ano nga samad o aksidente, pagkadula sang personal nga gamit, ukon emosyonal nga kasakit nga resulta sang pag-apil sa sini nga kompetisyon. Maging pamilyar sa [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/full/) antis mag-intra sa kompetisyon nga ini. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzU0ODMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--c50c26c64cb1b9f822467f54be10667c701e1a75/Untitled%20design%20(14).png)

venue.name: Kazakh Research Institute of Processing and Food Industry

items.information: 24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 – Астанадағы 24 сағаттық ашық жарыс. Бұл жарыстар 24 сағат үзіліссіз өтеді, сондықтан олар жас және жаңа қатысушыларға ұсынылмайды. Кез келген пәндер санына қатысу мүмкіндігімен базалық жарна 3000 теңгені құрайды. 1 кез келген пәнге тіркелу кезінде тіркеу жарнасы 1000 теңгені құрайды. Бұл жарыстарды QBERS TEAM ұйымдастырады. 24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 - это первые открытые 24-х часовые соревнования в Астане. Данные соревнования будут проходить без перерывов 24 часа, следовательно не рекомендуются для юных и новых участников. Базовый взнос с возможностью участия в любом количестве дисциплин составляет 3000 тенге. При регистрации на 1 любую дисциплину регистрационный взнос составит 1000 тенге. Данные сореванования организованы QBERS TEAM. 24 Hours Warm Up in Astana 2024 is the first open 24-hour competition in Astana. These competitions will take place without breaks for 24 hours, therefore they are not recommended for young and new participants. The base registration fee for any number of events is 3000 tenge. If you're participating in 1 event only, the registration fee is 1000 tenge. These competition is organized by QBERS TEAM.

items.information: (SRB) Belgrade Open 2024 je dvadeset i drugo po redu takmičenje koje se održava u Srbiji. Svako može da se takmiči, nezavisno od njihove nacionalnosti ili godina, ali moraju biti upoznati sa WCA Regulacijama i moraju da ih pročitaju pre takmičenja. **Cena kotizacije za ovo takmičenje zavisi od toga koje discipline slažete. Ukoliko se takmičite samo u 3x3 i 2x2 kocki cena kotizacije iznosi 1,000RSD , ali ukoliko se takmičite u više disciplina plaćate punu cenu od 2,000RSD. Ovo nije standardna praksa i ovo pravilo važi samo za ovo takmičenje.** ------------------------ (ENG) Belgrade Open 2024 is the 22nd speedcubing competition in a row that's being held in Serbia. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and read them before the competition. **Registration fee for this competition depends on which events you are competing in. If you are competing in only 3x3 and 2x2 cubes, you will pay 1,000RSD, but if you are competing in more events, you will pay the full amount of 2,000RSD. This is not a standard practice, and this rule applies only to this competition.**

items.name: Kalvskinnet Kubing 2024
items.information: ## 🇳🇴 Informasjon Velkommen til Kalvskinnet Kubing 2024! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta. ### On The Spot Registreringer Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 50kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen. ### Førstegangsdeltakere Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å delta. Vi ber alle førstegangsdeltakere vennligst lese [Førstegangsdeltakere-fanen](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024#48216-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors). --- ## 🇺🇸 Information Welcome to Kalvskinnet Kubing 2024! The competition is open to all who wish to compete. ### On The Spot Registration Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 50 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot. ### First-Time Competitors First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition. We would like to ask all first-time competitors to read the [First-Time Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KalvskinnetKubing2024#48216-forstegangsdeltakere-first-time-competitors) tab.

items.information: # **Español** Les presentamos el gemelo opuesto de la famosa competencia de speedcubing de Monterrey: La Silla. La Sillan't es para aquellos que buscan algo diferente. Esta competencia tiene todas las categoriás que no son NxN, One-Handed y Blind, para que todos, con gustos distintos, también puedan disfrutar. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el[ Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) # **English** We present to you the opposite twin of the famous Monterrey speedcubing competition: La Silla. La Sillan't is for those looking for something different. This competition features all categories that are not NxN, One-Handed, and Blind, so that everyone with different tastes can also enjoy. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association event. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)

Vous serez remboursé si vous êtes toujours sur la liste d'attente à la fin de la période d'inscription. Lisez attentivement, ci-bas, toutes les conditions d'inscription avant de vous inscrire. *Si vous étudiez au Cégep Trois-Rivières, écrivez votre numéro matricule dans les commentaires de votre inscription*. Le déroulement de la compétition pourra vous paraître lent, car certaines limites de temps sont élevées. Consultez les autres onglets pour des informations additionnelles très importantes sur la compétition. *Note : Certains textes dans ce site web sont en anglais uniquement. Veuillez nous en excuser car les organisateurs ne peuvent faire autrement en utilisant ce site web*. ###**Avis de droit à l'image** Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leur image soit utilisée par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et sur d'autres plateformes numériques. ##**[EN]** There will be **no refunds after the registration period closes**. If you register and you are not able to come, please let us know as soon as possible to let someone else have a chance to participate. You will be refunded if you are still on the waiting list when the registration period closes. Please read all the terms and conditions below carefully before registering. *If you study at Cégep Trois-Rivières, please enter your matricule number in the comments of your registration*. The pace of the competition may seem slow to you, as some time limits are high. See the other tabs for very important additional information about the competition. ###**Notice of Filming and Photography** Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their image being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: ***English version is below*** **Deutsch:** Wir freuen uns sehr euch Vienna Autumn 2024 als ein offizielles WCA Turnier ankündigen zu können. Die Speedcubing Competition wird organisiert von Simon Praschl, Thomas Strasser, Martin Fröhlich und Jeremia Neuhold und delegiert von Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Erneut findet das Turnier im großen Saal der Akkonplatz Pfarre statt. Die Resultate dieser Competition werden zu den offiziellen WCA World Rankings hinzugefügt. Jeder ist bei diesem Turnier gerne willkommen, unabhängig von der Erfahrung, Alter oder sonstigen Fähigkeiten. Manche Events haben ein spezifisches Zeitlimit, damit wir sicherstellen können den ganzen Tag über im Zeitplan zu bleiben. Es dürfen Puzzles jeder Marke verwendet werden solange sie den WCA Richtlinien entsprechen. Es sind alle Herzlich willkommen! Jeder Teilnehmer darf einen Gast mitbringen. Wir freuen uns besonders auf neue Speedcuber aus Österreich! **English:** We are happy to announce the Vienna Autumn 2024 as an official WCA Competition. The speedcubing competition is organised by Simon Praschl, Thomas Strasser, Martin Fröhlich and Jeremia Neuhold and delegated by Florian Truckenthanner und Pranjal Khan. Results of the competition will be added to the official WCA World Rankings. The competition is open to all competitors regardless of experience and skill, but certain event-based time limits will be in place to make sure we can stay on schedule and get through the day on time. No prior experience in WCA competitions is necessary, but competitors must be familiar with the WCA Regulations. Any puzzle brand may be used during the competition, as long as it complies with the WCA regulations. Every Competitor can bring one guest.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) [EN] ### OCDSB Students! OCDSB students (Elementary and Secondary students) compete for free! Please add the following note in the comments of your registration: "OCDSB Student, my student email is {student email here}" Please do not pay the registration fee. ### Ottawa Fall Series This competition is in a series with Ottawa 3x3x3 Fall B 2024 (Saturday Morning) and Ottawa 3x3x3 Fall C 2024 (Saturday Afternoon). You will only be able to compete in one of these three competitions. Attempting to register for multiple of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ### Registration Reminders If you are not a OCDSB student, you must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. --- [FR] ### Les élèves de l'OCDSB! Les élèves de l'OCDSB (élèves du primaire et du secondaire) participent gratuitement aux compétitions! Veuillez ajouter la note suivante dans les commentaires de votre inscription: "Étudiant de l'OCDSB, mon email d'étudiant est {email d'étudiant ici}". Ne payez pas les frais d'inscription. ### Série d'automne d'Ottawa Cette compétition fait partie d'une série avec Ottawa 3x3x3 Fall B 2024 (samedi matin) et Ottawa 3x3x3 Fall C 2024 (samedi après-midi). Vous ne pourrez participer qu'à une seule de ces trois compétitions. Si vous tentez de vous inscrire à plusieurs de ces compétitions, une seule de vos inscriptions sera acceptée. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Si vous n'êtes pas un étudiant de l'OCDSB, vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzcxNjYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--62c69d32ea5b4a05a0c37f03abac9aab2f2a15c5/OP1.jpg) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al Nayarit Open 2024, una competencia más en el hermoso estado de **Nayarit**!. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced expert, this tournament provides a unique chance for everyone to participate, have fun, and experience the excitement of competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) [EN] ### OCDSB Students! OCDSB students (Elementary and Secondary students) compete for free! Please add the following note in the comments of your registration: "OCDSB Student, my student email is {student email here}" Please do not pay the registration fee. ### Ottawa Fall Series This competition is in a series with Ottawa 3x3x3 Fall A 2024 (Friday Evening) and Ottawa 3x3x3 Fall C 2024 (Saturday Afternoon). You will only be able to compete in one of these three competitions. Attempting to register for multiple of these competitions will result in only one of your registrations being accepted. ### Registration Reminders If you are not a OCDSB student, you must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. --- [FR] ### Les élèves de l'OCDSB! Les élèves de l'OCDSB (élèves du primaire et du secondaire) participent gratuitement aux compétitions! items.information: Els socis de l'ACSC reben un descompte del 15% després de la competició. Pots fer-te soci de l'ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat). Aquesta competició no té una categoria principal. El guanyador de la competició es decidirà mitjançant el “Sum of Ranks”. Això consisteix a sumar totes les posicions en què ha quedat un competidor a totes les categories, i qui obtingui el nombre més baix serà qui millor ha actuat en tot el llarg de la competició i, per tant, el guanyador. ​ Los socios de la ACSC reciben un descuento del 15% después de la competición. Puedes hacerte socio de la ACSC [aquí](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat). Esta competición no tiene una categoría principal. El ganador de la competición se decidirá mediante “Sum of Ranks”. Esto consiste a sumar todas las posiciones en que ha quedado un competidor en todas las categorías, y quién obtenga el número más bajo será quien mejor ha actuado a lo largo de toda la competición y, por tanto, el ganador. ​ The ACSC members will receive a 15% discount after the end of the competition. You can become a member of the ACSC [here](https://linktr.ee/speedcubingcat). This competition does not have a main event. The winner of the competition will be decided through the “Sum of Ranks”. This consists of adding all the positions in which a competitor has remained in all categories, and the one who obtain the lowest number will be the one who has performed best throughout the competition and, therefore, the winner.

items.name: Rubik's UK Championship 2024
items.information: ## Welcome to Rubik's UK Championship 2024! ### This year's UK National Championship! #### Please read ALL tabs before registering. ##### Spectators are welcome! Please read the information below, and the information in the [Guests, Spectators, and Media](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2024#41928-guests-spectators-and-media) tab. **Free T-Shirt:** By registering and attending Rubik's UK Championship 2024, you'll receive a Rubik's UK Championship 2024 T-shirt as a memento! **Please fill in your registration comment with your T-shirt size.** **Guests:** A fee of £5 for a guest wristband will be due for all spectators and competitors' guests. They will be available on the door, payable via cash or card. Competitors will receive lanyards, and their guests and spectators will receive wristbands, which are to be worn throughout the weekend for security reasons. **This includes parents/guardians of competitors.** Please note that the guest field in the registration form is for informational purposes only. **Newcomers:** Unfortunately, **this competition is not open to first-time competitors**. If you have not been to a competition before but would like to attend this one, you must attend another competition first. You can see all upcoming UK competitions [here](https://wca.ukca.org). **Qualification Requirements:** If you do not meet the qualification requirements outlined in the [Events tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionship2024#competition-events) in an official WCA competition by October 22nd you will not be eligible to compete in those events. You will not be able to add events to your registration which you do not qualify for, but can update your registration if you later qualify for them. Please note that **the only qualification for 2x2, 3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb is to have any average in the event.** **Final Round Advancements:** For all events with more than one round, we will be taking a minimum number of UK competitors to the final. If necessary, we will increase the size of the final by one competitor at a time until we have enough UK competitors. The requirements are as follows: 2x2, 4x4, 5x5, 6x6, 7x7, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 One-Handed, Clock, Megaminx, Pyraminx, Skewb, Square-1: 6 UK competitors; 3x3: 8 UK competitors. 3x3 Multiple Blindfolded has a Top 16 qualification requirement, similarly this must contain at least 6 UK competitors. **Fewest Moves:** FMC will **not** be held at this competition. To compete for the national champion title for FMC, you must compete at [Rubik's UK Championship FMC 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/RubiksUKChampionshipFMC2024). The winner of the FMC competition will be awarded their prize during the awards at Rubik's UK Championship 2024. **Please Note:** As this is the UK National Championship, only competitors who represent the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbng5IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--153ecb54fb75b7956c0701cb174dca72201b0444/image.png)

items.name: Norrlandsmästerskapet 2024
items.information: Välkomna till Norrlandsmästerskapet 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. Alla som vill är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett tidigare erfarenhet eller var i världen du bor. Notera dock att det endast är deltagare som bor i Norrland som kan vinna titlar och priser på Norrlandsmästerskapet, läs mer om detta under fliken "[Regionala Mästerskap](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Norrlandsmasterskapet2024#43369-regionala-masterskap-2024-regional-championships-2024)". ----- Welcome to Norrlandsmästerskapet 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. Anyone who wants is warmly welcome to participate, regardless of previous experience or where in the world you live. Note, however, that only competitors who live in Norrland can win titles and prizes at the Norrland Championship, read more about this under the tab "[Regional Championships](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/Norrlandsmasterskapet2024#43369-regionala-masterskap-2024-regional-championships-2024)". items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa0Y3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--da1436f51b6bdf99f61924b5ef7f58cd5d26107f/Coralito%20(1).png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al Coralito Bahía De Banderas 2024, la tercera competencia oficial en el hermoso estado de Nayarit y primera en el municipio de Bahía de Banderas!. Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo en la ciudad de La Cruz de Huanacaxtle los días 9 y 10 de noviembre de 2024. El Coralito Bahía De Banderas 2024 reunirá a cuberos de todo el estado de Nayarit y más allá, brindándoles la oportunidad de mostrar su destreza y competir en una variedad de modalidades y categorías. Tanto si eres un principiante como un profesional experimentado, este torneo ofrece una oportunidad para que todos participen y se diviertan. Esta competencia es organizada por el Team Nayarit y la comunidad Vallarta Speed. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ###### English Welcome to Coralito Bahía De Banderas 2024, the third official competition in the beautiful state of Nayarit and the first one in the municipality of Bahía de Banderas! This exciting and fast-paced event will take place in the city of La Cruz de Huanacaxtle on November 9th and 10th, 2024. The Coralito Bahía De Banderas will bring together cubers from all over the state of Nayarit and beyond, providing them with the opportunity to showcase their skills and compete in a variety of events and categories. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned pro, this tournament offers a chance for everyone to participate and have fun. This competition is organized by Team Nayarit and the Vallarta Speed community. This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competitor Responsibilities tab. How to get to Venue: There are two entrances. If you entered through the doors with a sky bridge above, turn left to take elevators or turn left at the middle of the building to go upstairs. items.information: We're excited to welcome competitors back to Bozeman for another fun day of speedcubing! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition! Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 7:30 AM. If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (12:00 AM UTC 11-13-2024) This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## [EN] ### Please be quiet All of the events at this competition are ***blindfolded events***, which require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. ### Note for new competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. ### Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ### Competitor Requirements This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). If you are a new competitor, this video expains what to expect at your first competition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY). Please see tabs for more information about the competition. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ## [FR] ### Silence s'il vous plaît Toutes les épreuves de cette compétition sont des épreuves ***avec les yeux bandés***, qui nécessitent une quantité importante d'apprentissage, d'entraînement et de concentration. Toutes les personnes présentes, y compris les participants et les accompagnateurs, sont priées de ne pas faire de bruit afin de permettre aux participants de se concentrer. ### Note pour les nouveaux compétiteurs Bien que les novices soient les bienvenus s'ils savent résoudre des casse-tête les yeux bandés (voir le règlement [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)) ou le défi des moindres mouvements (3x3 Résolution optimisée), il se peut que cette compétition ne soit pas la meilleure expérience pour les nouveaux compétiteurs. Veuillez envisager de vous inscrire à [une autre compétition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) si celle-ci ne vous convient pas. ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzcxMTgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--65176dceb5a653113b9a7ce41294d2d1043cdf37/yollotl.png) **ESPAÑOL** El amor por los cubos va más allá de solo resolver un rompecabezas; es una pasión que desafía la mente, agudiza la concentración y une a personas con el mismo entusiasmo. En la competencia Yollotl Tlaxcala 2024, te invitamos a ser parte de esta experiencia única, donde no solo pondrás a prueba tu habilidad y velocidad, sino que también compartirás momentos inolvidables con una comunidad vibrante de cuberos. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia oficial de la Asociación Mundial de Cubos. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. **English** The love for cubes goes beyond just solving a puzzle; it's a passion that challenges the mind, sharpens focus, and brings together people who share the same enthusiasm. At the Yollotl Tlaxcala 2024 competition, we invite you to be part of this unique experience, where you'll not only test your skill and speed but also share unforgettable moments with a vibrant community of cubers. This competition is recognized as an official competition of the World Cube Association. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) prior to competition.

Therefore, all competitors should be familiar with the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). For a summary of the most important regulations, please refer to the following resources: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0). Please see tabs for more information about the competition. ### Mailing List Please follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ### Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ## [FR] ### Rappels concernant l'inscription Vous devez vous inscrire *et payer les frais d'inscription* avant que votre inscription ne soit acceptée. Les inscriptions non payées ne seront pas acceptées. Voir les sections **Liste des compétiteurs** et **Liste d'attente** au bas de cette page pour plus de détails. ### Exigences pour les compétiteurs Cette compétition est reconnue comme une compétition officielle de la World Cube Association. Par conséquent, tous les compétiteurs doivent être familiers avec les [règlements de la WCA] (https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Pour un résumé des règlements les plus importants, veuillez vous référer aux ressources suivantes: [WCA Competition Tutorial](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/edudoc/competitor-tutorial/tutorial.pdf) & [The basics of an official WCA competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vz1V0Gv0qX0) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Pour les nouveaux compétiteurs, cette vidéo explique à quoi s'attendre lors de votre première compétition: [What to expect at your first competition](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xK2ycvTfgUY) (des sous-titres en français disponibles). Veuillez consulter les onglets pour plus d'informations sur la compétition. ### Liste de diffusion Veuillez suivre [Speedcubing Canada] (https://speedcubingcanada.org/fr) sur les réseaux sociaux et/ou [vous inscrire à notre liste de diffusion](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) pour vous tenir au courant des annonces de compétitions. ### Avis de droit à l'image Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzgyMjcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d2d863a4d2dedc89e489091eae12bffb06986edb/menlyn.png) [Menlyn Park](https://www.menlynpark.co.za) is the main host for this event. A big thank you to the events department from Menlyn Park that has gone to very far lengths to provide us with their facilities and equipment for this competition. Menlyn Park is also providing prizes through store partners in all different categories for this event. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzgyMjgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--d1f95f10cca6c70419c1d2f0af053c637d4fdb6f/Cubestuff%20Small-Photoroom.jpg) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za/) who will co host and provide prizes for this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Please be aware that we will likely run ahead of schedule throughout the weekend. Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. To all competitors competing in the 3x3-Blinfolded event - Please be aware that the venue is located in a busy shopping centre and that there will likely be a lot of distractions during the event. ## NOTICE OF FILMING Please note that there will be filming and photography at this event. You therefore consent to your image being used by CubingZA and its partners in their marketing and social media platforms by attending. #### About CubingZA ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc4NzgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--32984d244f55e182cf16e089cf3f8466caffc2ac/image.png) CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, [please get in touch.](https://cubingza.org/contact)

items.name: FMC Canada 2024
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## FMC Canada 2024 ### [EN] [EN] This competition will have competitors simultaneously competing in 3x3x3 Fewest Moves at different locations across Canada with one winner. This isn't your typical speed solving competition as 3x3x3 Fewest Moves is the only event. This is an **exam-style event** in which competitors spend up to an hour finding the shortest solution they can and **writing it down on paper**. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 speed solving event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ### [FR] [FR] Cette compétition de 3x3 résolution optimisée aura lieu dans différents endroits simultanément à travers le Canada et aura un seul gagnant. Dans le cadre de cette compétition, des compétiteurs participeront simultanément à l'épreuve du 3x3x3 résolution optimisée à différents endroits au Canada et un seul gagnant sera désigné. Il ne s'agit pas d'une compétition typique où il faut résoudre le plus vite possible, car la seule épreuve est le 3x3x3 résolution optimisée. Il s'agit d'une **épreuve de type examen** au cours de laquelle les compétiteurs passent jusqu'à une heure à trouver la solution la plus courte possible et à **l'écrire sur papier**. Si vous cherchez à participer à une compétition de speedcubing plus classique, merci de chercher [une autre compétition au Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). --- ## Locations / Lieux ### [EN] Please see the [Locations tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2024#45461-locations-lieux) for more details. ### [FR] Merci de regarder [l'onglet lieux](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2024#45461-locations-lieux) pour plus de détails. --- ## Notice of Filming and Photography / Avis de droit à l'image ### [EN] Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms. ### [FR] Les participants aux compétitions de Speedcubing Canada consentent à ce que leurs images soient utilisées par Speedcubing Canada et ses partenaires dans de cadre de la promotion de ses activités notamment sur les réseaux sociaux et autres plateformes numériques.

items.name: Mississauga Blindfolded 2024
items.information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcGd3IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--413963af1d32608ec1038d304a181c8adedb8510/SpeedcubingCanadaLogo-724.png)](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) ## Please Be Quiet This isn't your typical speed solving competition as ***blindfolded events*** are the only events. Blindfolded events require a significant amount of learning, practice and concentration. All attendees, including competitors and guests, are asked to please remain quiet at this competition to allow competitors to concentrate. If you are looking to compete in the traditional 3x3x3 Cube event or other timed events, please look for [another competition in Canada](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada). ## FMC Canada 2024 We will take a break in the middle of the day to hold [FMC Canada 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMCCanada2024) at the same venue. You may compete in both competitions, but **you must register for each competition separately**. ## Note for New Competitors Although first-timers are welcome to compete if they know how to solve puzzles blindfolded (please note Regulation [2k6](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2k6)), this might not be the best experience for new competitors. Please consider registering for [another competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions?region=Canada) if this one isn't for you. You can also follow [Speedcubing Canada](https://www.speedcubingcanada.org/) on social media and/or [join our mailing list](https://share.hsforms.com/1eWkfr6anSF-HKTZJVrElZQcrqzz) to keep up-to-date on competition announcements. ## Registration Reminders You must register *and pay the registration fee* before your registration can be accepted. Unpaid registrations will not be accepted. See the **Competitor List** and **Waiting List** sections near the bottom of this page for more details. ## Notice of Filming and Photography Attendees of Speedcubing Canada competitions consent to their images being used by Speedcubing Canada and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.

items.information: [CubingZA](https://www.cubingza.org/about) is excited to announce Cubing Bash Bloemfontein 2024! Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" tab, **and** pay for your ticket to confirm your entry. Please see **Registration Requirements** below for instructions and when registration opens. ### All New Competitors If this is your first time competing, or the first time your child or ward is competing, please ensure to bring with **ID (card, book, passport, birth certificate)** so that we can verify that the name is spelled correctly, the Date of Birth is correct, and the Nationality is correct. Please also ensure you have all the puzzles you need to compete - we do not supply puzzles for competitors. You are welcome to ask other competitors if you can borrow their puzzle for a certain event, but there is no guarantee. If you need a puzzle before the competition, check out www.speedcubes.co.za, to order your puzzles before the comp! A huge thanks to [Speedcubes](www.speedcubes.co.za) for sponsoring this competition! Please see the Sponsors tab for more information, and make sure to support the Speedcubes shop! ![Speedcubes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5NDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--f899ecbbd498c3dd38ea30276772dcc02470011a/NEW_SPEEDCUBE_LOGO_BLACK.webp)

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MzgxNjcsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--db49adff55638d00cf908aad968093aad8933de0/image.png) Mια εβδομάδα πριν ξεκινήσει το 2ο Εθνικό Πρωτάθλημα Cubing θα πραγματοποιηθεί το αγώνισμα του FMC (Fewest Moves Challenge, Δοκιμασία λύσης 3x3 με τις λιγότερες κινήσεις) για το εθνικό πρωτάθλημα του 2024. Παρακαλούμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες σχετικά με το FMC Greek Nationals 2024. *Tην ίδια μέρα μετά την ολοκλήρωση του αγωνίσματος του FMC θα πραγματοιποιηθεί στον ίδιο χώρο και η συνάντηση όλων των Cubers πριν από το πρωτάθλημα (Pre Nationals MeetUp) Σημαντική Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στη WCA KAI να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών Stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων του Ρούμπικ.](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x5KaXXoh7XI) One week before the 2nd National Cubing Championship, the FMC competition for the Greek Nationals 2024 (Fewest Moves Challenge) will take place. items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** Competitors under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children.
