items.information: **(Português) Brasileiro** É com grande alegria que anunciamos mais um Capivara! Desde o ano passados, estamos trabalhando com doações para fins filantrópicos, assim, além de nos divertirmos, também ajudamos a fazer um mundo melhor. Estamos trabalhando em conjunto com o [LEO e Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) para arrecadar brinquedos e alimentos para crianças carentes, então todo o lucro da competição será revertido para essa campanha. Além disso, se você quiser fazer uma doação no dia, também será muito bem-vinda. Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento correto, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações abaixo em "Requisitos para inscrição". Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=hfp2rKaN8jHPI_RL). É muito importante que você conheça todo o regulamento, que podem ser lido [aqui](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/). Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para as modalidades 'Feminino' e 'Iniciante', que tomarão como referência a classificação geral na modalidade '3x3x3'. **English** It is in great excitement that we announce a new Capivara! Starting last year, we are working with donations for philanthropic purposes, therefore, in addition to having fun, we can also help make a better world. We are working together with [LEO and Lions](https://www.lionsclubs.org/) to collect toys and food to children in need, so all profit from the competition will be directed to that campaign. Besides that, if you would like to give a donation on the spot, it will also be very welcome. Your registration will only be approved in the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information below in "Registration requirements". If you have any problem on how to register, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/dZQiw5v8Bm0?si=6Yf5Zun_nlTfECTy). It is very important that you know the regulations, which may be read [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). We will have awards for all official events, and also unofficial awards to the events 'Female' and 'Beginner', which will consider the final ranking in the '3x3x3' event.

items.information: ### WCAシリーズ大会 「Shonan AM/PM 2024」はWCAシリーズ大会です。 WCAシリーズ大会は複数の大会を一連のシリーズとして扱うもので、それらのうち**一つにのみ**参加できます。 複数に申込んだ場合は、申込完了日時が最も早いものだけを受理し、その他は無効となります。 このページは「Shonan AM/PM 2024」の「AM大会」のページです。 ・ [Shonan AM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ShonanAM2024)(**このページでは「AM大会」と表記**) ・ [Shonan PM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ShonanPM2024)(**このページでは「PM大会」と表記**) 各大会の種目、ラウンド数、開場時刻、定員は以下の通りです。 ・AM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 1ラウンド、2x2x2 キューブ 1ラウンド 開場時刻 9:10 定員80名 ・PM大会：3x3x3 キューブ 1ラウンド、3x3x3 片手 1ラウンド 開場時刻 14:10 定員80名 ### 当日の来場時刻 AM大会については、**必ず**受付時間内の9:10から9:40の間にお越しください。 PM大会については、開場時刻の14:10までは会場に入れません。**必ず**14:10から14:40の間にお越しください。 ※会場は一般の企業も使用するオフィスビルのため、**会場前の廊下など建物内での待機はできません。** ### 参加費の支払い方法 参加費は受付時にお支払いください。 支払い方法は現金のみです。 ### 同伴・見学 会場定員の都合上、同伴・見学は承認制をとっています。 今大会の同伴・見学は**1名まで** 、つまり**競技参加者と同伴者の合計2名**でのご来場となります。申込時に同伴者の有無を申告してください。**事前申請のない来場は入場をお断りする場合があります。** 申請の承認は申し込み期間終了後に来場希望総数を集計してから決定いたします。 希望者が多数の場合は年少者の保護者などを優先的に承認することがあります。あらかじめご了承ください。 ### ジャッジ・スクランブラー等の役割分担 WCA大会では、ご自身の競技参加のほか、他者の競技スタッフとしてジャッジやスクランブラ―をはじめとした役割が割り振られます。個人ごとの役割分担表は参加申し込み締め切り後にお伝えします。 競技参加者が年少者の場合など、自身での担当が困難なときには保護者などに代理でご協力いただくことがあります。具体的な作業の流れを確認する時間を大会当日に設けますので、不慣れな方は必ずご参加ください。 関連競技規則[1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/japanese/#1e2)および 競技規則[1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/japanese/#1f2) ### WCA Series Competitions Shonan AM/PM 2024 are recongnized as WCA series competitions. WCA series competitions are a series of multiple competitions. You can participate in **only one** of them. If you register for more than one competition in a series, only the earliest registration will be valid, and the others will be invalid. This page is for Shonan AM 2024. [Shonan AM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ShonanAM2024) (**In this page, called "AM"**) [Shonan PM 2024](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ShonanPM2024) (**In this page, called "PM"**) The events, number of rounds, opening time, and maximum number of players for each event are as follows: AM : 3x3x3 Cube 1 round, 2x2x2 Cube 1 round, open at 9:10, limit of competitors 80 PM : 3x3x3 Cube 1 round, 3x3x3 One-Handed 1 round, open at 14:10, limit of competitors 80 ### Arrival Information For the AM competition, **please be sure to arrive during check-in hours between 9:10 and 9:40.** For the PM competition, **please be sure to arrive during check-in hours between 14:10 and 14:40.** Competitors won't be allowed to enter until 14:10. *Other business company office is near the venue. Do not stay in the building hallway before check-in. ### How to pay the participation fee Please pay the participation fee at check-in. Payment must be made in cash only. ### Limit of non-competitor Guest Guest entry requires approval due to venue capacity. Each competitor may request bringing up to one non-competitor guest with prior declaration on the registration. **Guest without prior application may be refused entry. ** Approval of your request will be determined after the total number of attendees requested is fixed after the registration period ends. If there are a large number of applicants, gardians of minors might be prioritized. ### The roles of judge and scrambler According to regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors must be prepared to perform duties as judges, scramblers and other rolles required. For younger competitors or those unable to fulfill these roles, we may ask parents or guardians to assist on their behalf. Staff procedures will be lectured at the venue.

Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije natjecanja. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Za više informacija, proučite ostale kartice na stranici natjecanja. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations. This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the competition organization. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia. For more information, check other tabs on the competition website.

items.name: Cape Cubes Challenge 2024
items.information: CubingZA is excited to announce the final Cape Town competition for 2024 - Cape Cubes Challenge! This competition will focus on a variety of popular events across two days. Don't forget that to participate you need to register for the competition in the "Register" section, and pay for your entry. Please see **Registration Requirements** below. Please keep in mind that we **will not** be accepting on-the-day registration. We are going to be using printed nametags and the Competition Groups website for competitor roles and duties and to do this we will need to close the registration period before the competition begins. A huge thanks to [Speedcubes](www.speedcubes.co.za) for sponsoring this competition! Please see the Sponsors tab for more information, and make sure to support the Speedcubes shop at the competition. ![Speedcubes](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5NDUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--f899ecbbd498c3dd38ea30276772dcc02470011a/NEW_SPEEDCUBE_LOGO_BLACK.webp) **SPECTATORS** Competitors are welcome to bring up to two spectators with them. **VOLUNTEERING** Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8).

items.name: Centennial State Cube Off 2024
items.information: We're excited to welcome competitors back to Erie for another fun day of speedcubing! Please make sure to read all tabs before registering. These tabs include important information regarding your responsibilities as a competitor and are very important! This competition has a 100 competitor limit. Please try to limit your guests that you bring to the competition! Competitions fill quickly, so it is recommended you register as soon as possible to save a spot. Be sure to familiarize yourself with the WCA regulations. If this is your first competition, please be present for the competitor tutorial at 7:45 AM. If you are unable to make the competition, please withdraw your registration as soon as possible by emailing the organizing team, to ensure competitors on the waitlist can compete. You will receive a 50 percent refund if you drop before the withdrawal deadline of (11:00 PM UTC 12-06-2024) This competition is financially supported by Colorado Cubers!

REGISTRO A participação nessa competição requer do competidor o conhecimento dos seguintes requisitos: Estar familiarizado com o Regulamento da WCA; **Se inscrever através do site da WCA, realizar o pagamento de forma antecipada e mandar o comprovante para o organizador através do e-mail (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) indicando o nome completo do participante;** **Caso não seja informado o nome do competidor, a inscrição NÃO SERÁ ACEITA** Aguardar até que o registro eletrônico seja aceito. Caso não participe mesmo com o pagamento, não haverá devolução do dinheiro. Há um limite de 40 competidores Outras informações adicionais verifique no site da WCA ou entre em contato com um dos Delegados através do e-mail. **VOCÊ SÓ PODE SE REGISTRAR PARA UMA COMPETIÇÃO NESTA SÉRIE! CASO SE REGISTRE NAS DUAS COMPETIÇÕES, SUA INSCRIÇÃO SERÁ REMOVIDA DA COMPETIÇÃO QUE TIVER MENOS COMPETIDORES** **ATENÇÃO: HAVERÁ INSCRIÇÕES NO DIA, MAS AS VAGAS SÃO LIMITADAS; PORTANTO, PRIORIZE SE INSCREVER O QUANTO ANTES** REGISTRATION The participation in this competition requires the comprehension and acceptance of the following requirements: **Register through the WCA website, pay in advance and send proof to the organizer via email (bahiacubomagico@gmail.com) indicating the participant's full name;** **If the name of the competitor is not informed, the registration WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED** Wait for your registration to be approved online. In the case of not participating and having already paid the registration, no money will be returned There will be a limit of 40 competitors. For additional information, check the WCA website or contact one of the Delegates via email. **YOU CAN ONLY REGISTER AT ONE COMPETITION IN THIS SERIES! items.information: ##### 🇧🇷 O **Pé Vermelho II** é a segunda edição do nosso campeonato **aberto** e **beneficente**. Aqui estão algumas instruções e lembretes para quem pretende participar: * Todas as informações sobre inscrição no evento podem ser encontradas na aba [Inscrever](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024/register). * As inscrições vão até o dia **07/12/2024**, ou até que o **limite de 70 competidores** seja atingido. Após essa data, só será possível a inscrição no dia do campeonato, caso haja vagas remanescentes. * Fique atento aos horários de credenciamento na aba [Cronograma](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024#competition-schedule). Chegue com antecedência para fazer seu credenciamento antes de qualquer modalidade que você for participar. * Todos os competidores devem apresentar documento válido com foto no credenciamento. * É necessário que todos os participantes leiam o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. * O cubo com o qual você vai competir deve estar em bom estado, portanto, cuide bem dele. Caso contrário, o cubo pode não ser aceito para a competição. * Caso seja seu primeiro campeonato, assista [este vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE). * Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal. * Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar. Mande suas dúvidas para a [organização](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com) e faremos o melhor possível para ajudar. Sempre há espaço para novos competidores! * Divirta-se! --- ##### 🇺🇸 **Pé Vermelho II** is the second edition of our **open charity** competition. Here are some instructions and reminders for those who wish to participate: * All information regarding registration can be found in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024/register) tab. * Registration closes on **12/07/2024**, or whenever the **limit of 70 competitors** is reached. After that, it will only be possible to register in the day of the competition, if there are still vacancies. * Pay attention to check-in times in the [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PeVermelhoIILondrina2024#competition-schedule) tab. Please arrive early in order to check-in before participating in any event. * All competitors must present a valid document at the check-in. * All participants must read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. * The cube with which you will compete must be in good condition, so take good care of it. Otherwise, your cube may not be approved for the competition. * If this is your first competition, watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EFKDwkhPJJE). * There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian. * If you have any questions, do not hesitate to ask. You can e-mail your questions to the [organization](diego.quintanilha@hotmail.com), and we will do our best to help you. There is always room for new speedcubers! * Have fun! --- [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc1OTEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--930733faec45c31f0dd172905b90a8eceaa7b5f4/CUBOmenor.png)] (https://www.instagram.com/pevermelhocubo/) ### Realização: **Grupo Escoteiro Verde Vale - 3/PR** [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBdTlJIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--16e16932678a6610581fca6a2b80723d8549fe13/gevv.png)](https://www.instagram.com/geverdevale/) ### Apoio: **Associação Guarda Mirim de Londrina** [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBak5JIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--570d92311785515d92cf46545f84e0c0ed16a933/image.png)](https://www.guardamirimlondrina.org.br/)

Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. items.name: Success For Candy Stockholm 2024
items.information: Varmt välkomna till Success For Candy Stockholm 2024! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Notera dock att 3x3x3 inte kommer hållas på denna tävling. Eftersom DNF lär bli det vanligaste resultatet i tävlingens grenar kommer man få godis varje gång man får ett resultat som inte är DNF (och inte heller DNS)! Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. ----- Welcome to Success For Candy Stockholm 2024! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. Please note, however, that 3x3x3 will not be held at this competition. Since DNF will likely the most common result in most events of the competition, you will get candy every time you get a result that is not DNF (and not DNS either)! We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

items.information: ### On the spot registration is open for 2x2x2, 3x3x3, Pyraminx, and Skewb events only. Kejuaraan Speedcubing Nasional untuk Indonesia pada tahun 2024. Peserta dari segala usia dan kewarganegaraan dipersilakan untuk mengikuti. Harap diperhatikan tentang limit dan cutoff untuk setiap event, karena lebih ketat daripada kompetisi biasanya. Akan ada **2 jenis pemenang** dalam kompetisi ini: **Kategori Terbuka** - 3 pemenang teratas kompetisi tanpa memandang kewarganegaraan **Kategori Indonesia** - 3 pemenang teratas yang mewakili Indonesia di setiap kategori Peserta atau pendamping harus setuju bahwa penyelenggara, NSA, dan WCA tidak bertanggung jawab atas cedera pribadi, atau kerusakan atau kehilangan barang pribadi anda yang diakibatkan oleh partisipasi Anda dalam acara ini. Untuk informasi lebih lanjut, silakan periksa **Persyaratan Pendaftaran.** Biaya pendaftaran termasuk, Sertifikat Partisipasi, Lanyard, dan Name Tag. Silahkan melakukan registrasi di website WCA dan konfirmasi di [form ini](https://forms.gle/h89T8gudSJRxWPaF9) *Harap perhatikan jadwal selama periode pendaftaran terbuka karena dapat berubah tergantung pada jumlah orang yang mendaftar untuk setiap acara.* --- ### Registrasi OTS dibuka hanya untuk cabang 2x2x2, 3x3x3, Pyraminx, dan Skewb. The National Speedcubing Championship for Indonesia in 2024. Competitiors of all ages and nationality are welcomed to join. Please notice the time limit and cutoff on each events, as they are stricter than regular competitions. There will be **2 types of winners** in this competition: **Open Category** - Top 3 winners of the competition regardless of nationality **Indonesian Category** - Top 3 winners representing the Indonesia in each category Competitor or guardian must agree that the organizers, NSA and WCA shall not be liable for any personal injury, property damage or loss resulting from your participation of this event. For more information, please check the **Registration Requirements.** Registration fee includes, Certificate of Participation, Lanyard and Name Tag. Please register in the WCA website and confirm your registration by filling out [this form](https://forms.gle/h89T8gudSJRxWPaF9) *Please keep an eye on our schedule during the open registration period as it may change depending on the number of people registering for each event.*

We apologize for any confusion caused. # 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다. # [참관객 제한](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentKoreaWinter2024#48982-spectator-restriction)이 존재합니다. ### 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대기자 명단에 등록됩니다. ### 신청 후 [참가자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/54/competitors)에서 본인의 이름을 확인하십시오. 이름이 보이지 않을 경우 [대기자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/54/waitlist)을 확인하여 주십시오. ### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ # There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition. # There is a [Spectator Restriction](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SilentKoreaWinter2024#48982-spectator-restriction). ### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist. ### After registration, please check your name on the [competitor list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/54/competitors). Please check the [wait list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/54/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list. ### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

items.information: This competition, Krungthep Farewell 2024, is organised by ThailandCube to bid farewell to the old year and celebrate the new year. Since 2022, Krungthep Farewell has been organised by ThailandCube, and this year welcomes its third edition. We hope that all attendees, whether as a competitor or a spectator, enjoy the competition and return with good memories for years to come! การแข่งขันนี้ ในชื่อของ "Krungthep Farewell 2024" ถูกจัดขึ้นโดยชมรมลูกบาศก์ไทย เพื่อส่งท้ายปีเก่า และต้อนรับปีใหม่ โดยการแข่งขันครั้งนี้จัดขึ้นเป็นปีที่ 3 แล้ว นับตั้งแต่ปี 2022 เราหวังว่าทุกคนที่มีส่วนร่วม ไม่ว่าจะเป็นในฐานะผู้เข้าแข่งขันหรือผู้เข้าชมจะได้รับประสบการณ์ที่ดีกลับไปครับ! **As this competition does not include the 3x3x3 Cube event, we do not recommend this competition to those who do not have experience in speedcubing competitons.** **การแข่งขันนี้ไม่มีแข่งประเภท 3x3x3 ทางคณะผู้จัดไม่แนะนำสำหรับผู้เข้าแข่งขันใหม่** **For additional information, please see other tabs. สำหรับข้อมูลอื่น ๆ สามารถดูได้ในช่องแท็บ** ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDYwMDksInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--7b61ca8e1e12680142e99c4b76473b5b40136e37/005%20KTFW2024%20(for%20Website).png)

items.information: The Community Space is located in the back of University Mall, directly underneath Giant Food and next to Patriot Pawsabilities. Available seating will be limited. items.name: Chääswürfel 2024
items.information: [DE] Nach dem Turnier veranstalten wir ein gemeinsames Raclette-Essen. Wir würden uns freuen, wenn auch du dabei bist und zusammen mit uns ins neue Jahr "cubest". Im **Tab "Raclette" f**indest du alle wichtigen Informationen. Bitte beachte, dass der **Anmeldeschluss für das Raclette-Essen vor Anmeldeschluss der Competition liegt**. [EN] After the competition, we will have a raclette dinner together. We would be delighted if you could join us and "cube" into the new year. You can find all the important information in the **"Raclette" tab**. Please note that the **registration deadline for the raclette dinner is before the competition registration deadline**.

items.name: New New York New Year 2024
items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab. Please note the schedule of this competition - there are events/rounds taking place from **9pm** on New Year's Eve (December 31, 2024) to **2am** on New Year's Day (January 1, 2025), and then 9:30am to 1:30pm on New Year's Day.
